entries.q: Ibimenyetso bigenga uburyo bwo kugenda mu muhanda birimo ibyiciro bingahe? Bivuge
entries.a: Ni bitatu (3): art 91.1; Ibyapa; Ibimenyetso bimurika; Ibimenyetso byo mumuhanda

entries.q: Vuga uko ibitegekwa mu nzira nyabagendwa birushanya agaciro.
entries.a: Ibitegekwa n'abakozi babifitiye ububasha birusha agaciro ibindi bimenyetso. (art 5.6); Ibimenyetso bimurika birusha ububasha ibyapa n'ibimenyetso byo mumuhanda (art 91.2)

entries.q: ishyirwaho ry'ibimenyetso rigengwa na nde? Art 91 . 4
entries.a: Minisitiri ushinzwe gutwara abantu n'ibintu ku mihanda y'igihugu n'iy'Imigi; Njyanama z'uturere ku byerekeye imihanda y'uturere

entries.q: Ibyapa byo ku muhanda bigizwe n'ubuhe bwoko bw'ibyapa? Art 92. 1
entries.a: Ibyapa biburira (A); Ibyapa byo gutambuka mbere (B); Ibyapa bibuza (C ); Ibyapa bitegeka (D); Ibyapa ndanga (E)

entries.q: Ibyapa byo kumuhanda bigomba gushingwa ku ruhe ruhande rw'umuhanda? Art 92. 2
entries.a: Kuruhande rw'iburyo bw'umuhanda

entries.q: Kubuhe buryo
entries.a: Kubuyo umusozo wo hasi utajya munsi ya 1,50 m cg hejuru ya 2,10 m uhereye kubutaka.

entries.q: Ubusobanuro bw'icyapa gishobora kuzuzwa , gusiganuwa cg kugenwa n'iki?
entries.a: N'ibyapa by'inyongera

entries.q: Ibyapa biburira bibereyeho kumenyesha umugenzi iki? Byerekana iki? Bimutegeka iki? Kubera iki? Art 93.1
entries.a: Bibereyeho kumenyesha umugenzi ko hali icyago; Byerekana imiterere yacyo; Bimutegeka ubwitonzi budasanzwe; Kugira ngo imigenzereze ye ihure n'imiterere n'ububi bw'icyago cyerekanwe

entries.q: Ibyapa byo gutambuka mbere bibereyeho iki? Art 93.1
entries.a: Bibereyeho kumenyesha abagenda mu nzira nyabagendwa amategeko yihariye yo gutambuka mbere mu nkomane.

entries.q: Ahatari mu nsisiro, ibyapa biburira n'ibyapa byo gutambuka mbere bigomba gushyirwa muntera ingana ite? Art 94.2
entries.a: mu ntera kuva kuri 150 m kugera kurli 200 m y'ahantu habi byerekana

entries.q: Iyo ahantu icyago cyaranzwe ari harehare uburebure bw'igice cy'inzira nyabaendwa icyo cyago kirimo bushobora kwerekanwa n'ikihe cyapa? (Art 94.4)
entries.a: Icyapa cy'inyongera F:2

entries.q: Mu nsisiro, ibyapa biburira bigomba gushyirwa he?
entries.a: Iruhande neza rw'ahantu habi

entries.q: Icapa cyo gitanga uburenganzira bwo gutambuka mbere gisobora gushyirwa ku nzira nyabagendwa gusa iyo andi mayira yose arasukira mu masangano ariho icyapa gitegeka gutanga inzira cg guhagarara akanya gato (STOP). 95.
entries.a: Icyapa k'inyongera kigizwe n'akarangakerekezo kirabura gashobora kwerekana icyerekezo cy'ahantu habi.

entries.q: Ibyapa bitegeka n'ibyapa bibuza bitandukanwa bite? Art 97.1
entries.a: Ibyapa bibuza: Bimeze nk'ingasire izengurutswe n'ibara ritukura kandi ubuso bukera (ibibuza guhagarara umwanya muto n'umunini bifite ubuso bw'ubururu); Ingasire igira ibara ry'ubururu iyo icyapa gitegeka.

entries.q: Ibyapa bibuza n'ibitegeka bikurikizwa mu kihe gice cy'inzira? Art 98
entries.a: Mu gice cy'inzira nyabagendwa kiri hagati y'aho bishinze n'inkomane ikurikiye ku ruhande rw'inzira bishinzeho.

entries.q: Iyo ibibuzwa byinshi byubahirizwa ahantu hamwe bigenda gute? Art 101
entries.a: Ibigereranyo bibyerekeye bishobora gushyirwa hamwe ku ngasire imwe

entries.q: Vuga umubare ntarengwa w'ibimenyetso bishobora gushyirwa kungasire imwe .
entries.a: Bitatu

entries.q: Ibyapa bitegeka bishyirwa ahantu hameze hate? Art 102
entries.a: Ahantu birushijeho kubonwa neza n'abo bigenewe

entries.q: Ibyapa biyobora bigamije iki? Art 103
entries.a: Bigamije kuyobora no gusobanurira abagenzi b'inzira nyabagendwa

entries.q: Ibimenyetso bimurika mu buryo bw'amatara bifite amatara angahe? yavuge kandi uyasobanure. Art 104.1
entries.a: Bigira amatara atatu; Itara ritukura: Birabujijwe kurenga icyo kimenyetso; Itara ry'umuhondo: Birabujijwe gutambuka umurongo wo guhagarara umwanya muto cg igihe uwo murongo udahari birabujijwe kurenga icyo kimenyetso ubwacyo, keretse iyo ryatse umuyobozi yamaze kurenga uwo murongo ashobora kwambukiranya amasangano gusa ari uko atateza abandi ibyago.; Itara ry'icyatsi: uburenganzira bwo kurenga icyo kimenyetso; NB. Amatara atukura n'ay'icyatsi kibisi y'ibimenyetso bimurika by'amabara abiri bisobanura kimwe n'amatara ahuje n'ayak ku buryo butatu. Iyo yakiye rimwe asobanura kimwe n'itara ry'umuhondo mu buryo bwakamo amatara atatu. Art 104.5

entries.q: Iyo ikimenyetso kimurika cyagenewe ibinyabiziga kidakora bigenda bite? Art 104. 6
entries.a: Itegeko rigenga gutambuka mbere kw'iburyo rirakurikizwa, keretse iyo harinicyapa cyerekana ko uturutse inzira iyi n'iyi ariwe uhita mbere y'abaturutse mu zindi

entries.q: Aamatara ashyirwa kubimenyetso bimurika akurikirana ate? Mu buryo bwo kwaka akurikirana ate? Art 105
entries.a: Itara ritukura riba hejuru; Umuhondo hagati; Icyansi hasi,; NB. Amatara y'inyondera agizwe n'akarangacerekezo k'ibara ry'icyatsi kibisi, ashyirwa mu sni cg iruhande rw'itara ry'icyatsi kibisi.; Yaka akurikirana muburyo bukurikira; Itara ry'umuhondo ryaka nyuma y'itara ry'icyatsi kibisi,; Itara ritukura ryaka nyuma y'itara ry'umuhondo; Itara ry'icyatsi ryaka nyuma y'itara ritukura; Iyo ari kubimenyetso by'uburyo bw'amatara abiri:; Itara ritukura n'itara ry'icyatsi kibisi azima akurikirana yabanje kwakirizwa rimwe.

entries.q: Ibimenyetso bimurika byerekana iki? Bishyirwa he? Art 106
entries.a: Byerekana uburyo bwo kugenda mumuhanda; Bishyirwa iburyo bw'umuhanda ukurikije icyerekezo abagenzi bireba baganamo. Ariko, bishobora no gushyirwa ibumosso cyangwa hejuru y'umuhanda n'ahandi hose bitunganiye uburyo bwo kugenda mu muhanda, kugirango birusheho kugaragara neza.; NB. Ahantu uburyo bwo kugenda mu muhanda byerekanwa n'ibimenyetso bimurika, ibinyabiziga bishobora kuhagenda biteganye n'aho umubare wabyo utatuma biba ngmbwa.

entries.q: Kugirango berrekane ahantu habi cyane, hakoreshwa ikihe kimenyetso? Bivuga iki? Art 107
entries.a: Hakoreshwa ikimenyetso k'itara ry'umuhondo rimyatsa; Rivuga uburenganzira bwo gutambuka icyo kimenyetso barushijeho kwitonda; Ntacyo rihindura ku mategeko agenga guhita mbere, kandi rikoreshwa nijoro no kumanywa.; NB: Iyo rikoreshejwe mu masangano y'amayira ahwanije agaciro, rishyirwa kuri buri nzira cg hagati y'amasangano kuburyo ribonwa n'umuyobozi wese ugiye kuyinjiramo.; Iyo rimyatsa rir ku kintu kimwe n'ibimenyetso bimurika byerekana uburyo bwo kugenda mu muhanda, cyangwa hafi yabyo ntirshobora kwakira rimwe nabyo.

entries.q: Amatara cg Ibikoresho ngarura -rumuri bikoreshwa kubera iki? Art 108
entries.a: Bikoreshwa kugirango bigaragaze inkengero z'inzira nyabagendwa bigomba gushyirwaho kuburyo abagenda kuri iyo nkengero babibona; Iburyo ni ibara ritukura cg isa n'icunga; Ibumoso n'ibara ryera

entries.q: Ibimenyetso byo mumuhanda bigenewe iki? Art 109
entries.a: Bigenewe gutunganya uburyo bwo kugendera mu muhanda cg kuburira gc de kuyobora abagendera mu muhanda.

entries.q: Ibimenyetso birombereje bigizwe n'imirongo iteganye n'umurongo ugabanyamo umuhanda mo kabiri bishobora kuba bigizwe n'iki? Art 110.1
entries.a: Umurongo udacagaguye; Umurongo ucagaguye; Umurongo udacagauye n'umurongo ucagaguye ibangikanye; Petite notes (Art 11O.2, 3...); Birabujijwe kurenga umurongo wera udacagaguye; Umurongo ucagaguye birabujijwe kuwurenga, keretse mu gihe agomba kunyura ku kindi kinyabiziga, gukatira ibumoso, guhindukira cgangwa kujya mu kindi gice cy'umuhanda.; Iyo uduce tw'umurongo ari tugufi kandi twegeranye cyane, tuvuga ko umurongo ukomeza wegereje.; Iyo umurongo wera ukomeje n'umurongo wera ucagaguye ibangikanye umuyobozi agomba kwita gusa ku murongo urushijeho kumwegera.

entries.q: Mu muhanda ufite igice banyuramo gikikijwe n'uduce tugari tudafatanye tw'ibara ryera hagomba guca ibihe binyabiziga ? 110.5
entries.a: Ibinyabiziga bigenda buhoro n'ibinyabiziga bitwara abantu muri rusange, bigomba kunyura muri icyo gice cy'umuhanda.

entries.q: Igice cy'inzira nyabagendwa kigarukira kumirongo ibiri yera icagaguye ibangikanye kandi gifite ubugari budahagije kiba kigeewe iki ? Art 110.6
entries.a: Kiba ari agahanda k'amagare

entries.q: Umurongo w'umuhondo ucagaguye uciye ku nkombe nyayo y'umuhanda, umusezero w'inzira y'abanyamaguru cyangwa w'inkengero y'umuhanda yegutse bivuga iki ? 110. 8
entries.a: Bivuga uguhagarara umwanya munini bibujijwe kuri uwo muhanda kuburebure bw'uwo murongo.

entries.q: Umurongo mugari udacagaguye ugaragaza iki ? 110.9
entries.a: Ushobora gucibwa kumuhanda kugirango ugaragaze inkombe zawe.; NB. Igice cyo hakurya y'uwo murongo hagenewe guhagararwa umwanya muto n'umwanya munini, keretse kubyerekeye imihanda irombereje y'ibisate byinshi n'imihanda y'imodoka.; Intangiriro n'iherezo ry'aho hahagararwa umwanya munini bishobora kugaragazwa n'umurongo wera udacagaguye wambukiranya umuhanda.

entries.q: Umurongo mugari wera udac gaguye uciye kuburyo bugororotse ku nkengero y'umuhanda werekana iki ?
entries.a: Werekana aho abayobozi b'ibinyabiziga bagomba guhagarara akanya gato gategetswe babyeretswe n'icyapa STOP

entries.q: Umurongo ugizwe na mpandeshatu nyampanga zifite amasonga yerekeye aho abayobozi zireba baturuka kandi uciye ku byuryo bugororotse ku nkengero y'umuhanda werekana iki ?
entries.a: Werekana aho abayobozi bagomba guhagarara akanya gato iyo bishoboka, kugirango batange inzira

entries.q: Ibimenyetso byerekana imirimo mu nzira nyabagendwa bishyirwaho nande? Bivanwaho nande? (113)
entries.a: Bishyirwaho n'uyikora kandi bivanwaho n'ukora imirimo iyo ikimara kurangira

entries.q: Ibimenyetso by'inkomyi bishyirwaho na nde? (113.2)
entries.a: Bishyirwaho n'ubutegetsi bushinzwe inzira nyabagendwa, iyo ari inkomyi idaturutse ku muntu, cg n'uwateye iyo nkomyi

entries.q: Iyo imirimo cg inkomyi biri ahantu hatoya bigomba gushyirwaho ibihe bimenyetso? (114.1)
entries.a: Hagati ya nimugoroba na mugitondo: amatara ashyiraho imbibe; Hagati ya mugitondo na nimugoroba: utubendera dutukura dufite byibura 50cm z'uruhande

entries.q: Igihe ikorwa ry'imirimo ribangamiye cyanee cg buke uburyo bwo kugenda mu muhanda ahakorerwa imirimo hagaragazwwa ku buryo bumeze bute? 114.2
entries.a: Ahitaruye hashyirwa icyapa kerekana ko hari imirimo ikorwa (A15); Aho imirimo ikorwa hashyirwa uruzitiro ruri ku mpera zombie.

entries.q: Umuyobozi agomba gukora iki ngo yirinde kwangiza umuhanda ? (9)
entries.a: Kugenda buhoro; Kugabanya ibyo ikinyabiziga kikoreye; Anyura indi nzira

entries.q: Ikinyabiziga cyose cg ibinyabiziga bikururana bigomba kugira iki ? (10.1)
entries.a: Bigomba kugira ubiyobora

entries.q: By'umwihariko, umuyobozi ntagomba guterwa imbogamizi igihe ayobora n'iki ? (10.2)
entries.a: No gukingirizwa bitewe n'umubare w'abagenzi cg n'uko bafashe imyanya,; Bitewe n'ibintu bitabonerana bometse ku birahure

entries.q: Imyaka y'ifatizo kugirango umuntu yemererwe kuyobora hakurikijwe urwego rw'ibyo ayobora n'iyihe?
entries.a: 20 ans (C,D,E, na F); 18 ans ( A na B); 15 Velomoteri na 17 ans ahetse; 14 ans (inyamaswa zikurura); 12 ans (amatungo)

entries.q: Kugenda ku mirongo ibangikanye byemewe he?
entries.a: Byemewe ku mihanda igenderwamo mu cyerekezo kimwe kandi igabanijwemo ibisate nbura bibiri (12.3); Ku gice cya kabiri cy'iburyo bw'umuhanda aho kubisikana mu muhande ufite ibice byinshi byemewe (12.3); Abakozi babifitiye ububasha bashobora kubitegeka

entries.q: Umuyobozi wese ugiye kugera mu nkomane agomba gukora iki? 15.1
entries.a: Kwitonda bihagije bijyanye n'uko aho agenda hameze;; Kureba niba umuhanda agiye kwinjiramo nta nkomyi irimo;; Kugenda agabanya umuvudukoakurikije uko asanga atabona

entries.q: Umuyobozi wese uvuye mu nzira nyabagendwa ifite ibyerekezo bibiri akaba ashaka kwinjira mu yindi ifite icyerekezo kimwe agomba gukora iki? 15.2
entries.a: Agomba kureka ibinyabiziga biyigezemo bigatambuka

entries.q: Umuyobozi ugiye kwinjira mu isangano aho bagomba kuzenguruka akora iki? 16.2
entries.a: Agomba kureka ibinyabiziga byagezemo bikabanza gutambuka

entries.q: Mbere yo gukata cyangwa kujya kuruhande rw'uuhanda, umuyobozi wese agomba mbere y'igihe gukora iki? 17
entries.a: Kubigaragaza kuburyo budashidikanywaho akoresheje indanga - cyerekezo cg ibirangacyerekezo by'ikinyabiziga cye byaba bidakora agakoresha ukuboko

entries.q: Kubisikana no kunyuranaho bireba nde? (19.1)
entries.a: Ibinyabiziga bigenda

entries.q: Iyo ubugari bw'inzira nyabagendwa budahagije kugirango ibisikana ryorohe, abayobozi bashobora gukora iki? Bategetswe iki? 20.3
entries.a: Kunyura mu nzira z'impande z'abanyamaguru ariko bitonze ngo badateza abanzinyuramo impanuka; Bategetswe koroherana kugirango batambuke (20.4)

entries.q: Mu mihanda yo mu misozi no mu nzira nyabagendwa zicuramye cyane cyane aho ibisikana ridashoboka cg riruhije, abayobozi babigenza bate? 20.5
entries.a: Umuyobozi umanuka agomba gushyira ikinyabiziga kuruhande ngo uzamuka abone uko ahita; Iyo ari ngombwa gusubira inyuma, abasubira inyuma ni abatwaye ibinyabiziga bidakomataye iyo bahuye n'abatwaye ibikomateanye;; Abatwaye ibinyabiziga bito iyo bahuye n'abatwaye ibinini; Abatwaye ibinyabiziga byikorreye imizigo iyo bahuye n'abatwaye ibinyabiziga bitwarira hamwe abantu (bus, taxi,..); Ibimanuka iyo bihuye n'ibizamuka (biri murwego rumwe) keretse iyo gusubira inyuma byoroheye uzamuka.

entries.q: Kunyuranaho bikorewa muruhe ruhande?
entries.a: Ibumoso

entries.q: Kunyuranaho bikorewe iburyo ryali? 21.1
entries.a: Iyo umuyobozi unyurwaho amaze kwerekana ko ashaka kugana ibumoso.

entries.q: Mbere yo kugira uwo anyuraho, umuyobozi wese agomba kwirngira iki? 21.2
entries.a: Agomba kwiringira ko:; Nta wndi muyobozi umukurikiye watangiye kumunyuraho; Umuyobozi umuri immbere atagaragaje ko ashaka kunyura k'uwundi cg gukatira ibumoso; Igisate agiye kunyuramo kitarimo inkomyi mu ntamwe zihagije; Ashobora kugarura ikinyabiziga cye iburyo atabangamiye abagenzi yanyuzeho; Kwerekana icyo agiye gukora kandi akabyereka uwo agiye gucaho

entries.q: Umuyobozi wese ubonye ko hari ugiye kumunyuraho agomba gukora iki? 21.6
entries.a: Kwegera uruhande rw'iburyo rw'umuhanda atongereye umuvuduko; Iyo ikinyabiziga gifite uburebure burenga 8m agomba, akoresheje ikimenyetso cyabigenewe cy'icyo kinyabiziga, kugaragaza ko yabonye ikimenyetso cy'umuyobozi ugiye kumunyuraho.

entries.q: Mu mihanda bagendamo mu byerekezo byombi, kunyuranaho ibumoso birabujijwe, bitewe n' iki? 22.1 - 2
entries.a: Bitewe n'impamvu nk'ibihu , kuba hafi y'ikoni cg y'impinga y'umupando, iyo umuyobozi adashobora kubonera abagenzi bamuturutse imbere mu ntambwe zihagije.; Iyo umuyobozi ugiye kunyuraho yerekana ko ashaka gukatira ibumoso

entries.q: Umuyobozi wese agomba kuringaniza umuvuduko w'ikinyabiziga akurikije iki? 26.1
entries.a: N'uko ahantu hameze; Uko habona; Imimerere y'umuhanda; Imimerere y'ikinyabiziga n'ibyo kikoreye; Imiterere y'ikirere; Ubwinshi bw'ibigenda

entries.q: Agomba guhagarika ikinyabiziga cye akurikije iki? 26.1
entries.a: Akurikije aho ageza amaso n'imbere y'inkomyi yose idatunguranye

entries.q: Iyo nta mategeko awugabanya by'umwihariko, umuvuduko ntarengwa w'ibinyabiziga uteye ute? 29.2
entries.a: 80 km/ h: Moto n'ibinyabiziga bitarenza 3500 kg; 70 km / h: Voitures + taxi bitarenza 3500kg; 60 kms /h: Bus + Ibifite uburemere buri hagati ya 3500 - 12500kg; 50 kms /h: Velomoteri + Ibinyabiziga bikomatanye n'ibifite plus de 12500 kg; 25 kms /h : Trotoro, ibihinga n'ibindi bitavuzwe haruguru

entries.q: Umuvuduko wo mu nsisiro : (29.3)
entries.a: 50 Kms / h : Ibinyabiziga byagenewe gusa gutwara abantu (moto, voiture); 40 Kms / h: Ibindi binyabiziga

entries.q: Uretse igihe hari amategeko abitegeka ukundi, ikinyabiziga cyose cg inyamaswa ihagaze umwanya muto cg munini igomba kua iri he?
entries.a: Mu kuboko kw'iburyo hakurikijwe aho yaganaga, yaba ari mu kerekezo kimwe ashobora kuba ari ibumoso; Ahegereye bishoboka akayira k'abanyamaguru ariko ntasige umwanya urenga 50 cm; Kure cyane y'umurongo ugabanya umuhanda mo kabiri

entries.q: Ni ibihe binyabiziga bibujijwe guhagarara umwanya munini mu gihe cy'iminsi irindwi ku nzira nyabagendwa? 32.3
entries.a: Ibinyabiziga bifite moteri bitagishoboye kugenda kumwe na za romoroko

entries.q: Vuga Ibinyabiziga iyo bihagaritswe ku muhanda bitagomba kurangirwa kure n'ikimenyetso cyabigenewe kugira ngo kiburire hakiri kare abandi bayobozi baza babisanga, iyo ari ni joro cg iyo umuyobozi agihagaritse ahantu habujijwe guhagarara (32.6)
entries.a: Velomoteri cg ipikipiki idafite akanyabiziga kari ku ruhande.

entries.q: Iyo nta mategeko yihariye akurikizwa, ni uwuhe mwanya usigara hagati y'ibinyabiziga bibiri bihagaze umwanya munini ku ruhande rumwe rw'umuhanda ubisikanirwamo?. 32.7
entries.a: Nibura 5m mu nsisiro; 20 m ahatari mu nsisiro

entries.q: Guhagarara akanya gato no guhagarara akanya kanini bibujijwe: (33.2)
entries.a: Mu duhanda tw'abanyamagare no mubice byagenewe abanyamaguru; Kunkengero zigiye hejyru, mu nzira z'abanyamaguru no mu nsisiro; Mu ruhande ruteganye n'urw'ikindi kinyabiziga gihagazemo akanya gato cg kanini (6 m ibisikanirwamo) (3 mu muhanda w'icyerekezo kimwe); Hejuu no munsi y'amateme no mumihanda inyura ikuzimu; Mu muhanda, mu ikoni; Ku mihanda ibisikanirwamo; Ahari ibimenyetso bibuza byabigenewee; N'ibindi

entries.q: Intabaza zihariye zigomba gukoreshwa ryali? Amatara yazo amyatsa asa ate? 36.1
entries.a: Mu gihe ikinyabiziga ndakumirwa kiri mu butumwa; Asa n'ubururu

entries.q: Intabaza ndangurura jui ikoreshwa ryali? 36.3
entries.a: igihe ikinyabiziga ndakumirwa kiri mu butumwa bwihutirwa

entries.q: Umugenzi uri mu nzira nyabagendwa iyo asatiriwe n'ikinyabiziga ndakumirwa kirangwa n'intabaza ndangurura jwi yihariye abigenza ate ? 37.1
entries.a: agomba kugihigamira ako kanya, byaba ngombwa agahagarara

entries.q: Imirongo y'ingabo n'udutsiko tw'abanyamaguru bagendera he mu muhanda ? 38.1
entries.a: Kuruhande rw'iburyo bw'umuhanda

entries.q: Abagenda mu nzira nyabagendwa babujijwe kwata (couper) :38.2
entries.a: Umurongo w'abasiikare bagenda cg imirongo y'ibinyabiziga by'ingabo zigihugu zigenda mu muhanda; Mu murongo w'abanyeshuli bayobowe n'umwalimu; Uruhererekane (cortge) NB : izi nkomyi ntizikurikizwa ku binyabiziga ndakumirwa

entries.q: Uruhushya rw'amasiganwa rutangwa na nde ? 39.2
entries.a: Umuyobozi w'akarere : Iyo bitarenga akarere kamwe; Umuyobozi w'intara : Iyo birenze akarere kamwe bitarenze intara imwe; Minisitiri w'ubutegetsi bw'igihugu : Iyo birenze intara imwe

entries.q: Uruhushya rw'amasiganwa cg imikino y'ibinyabiziga ruhabwa nde ? agomba kwerekana iki ? 39.3
entries.a: Ruhabwa gusa abtegura amasiganwa cg andi marushanwa y'ibinyabiziga; Berekana ko bafite ubwishingizi ku barushanwa no ku bintu by'abaje kureba iyo mikino.

entries.q: Uretse iyo icyapa kibyerekana ukundi, uburemere ntarengwa ku mateme akozwe mu biti cg mu mbaho bungana iki ? 40.2
entries.a: ni toni 8

entries.q: Iyo begereye ibyome, abayobozi bagitegereje gutambuka bagomba gukora iki ? 40.3
entries.a: Gutonda umurongo umwe no guhagarara iburyo bw'umuhanda.

entries.q: Ibinyabiziga byemerewe gutambuka mbere y'ibindi, iyo byegereye ibyome ni ibihe? 40.3
entries.a: Ibinyabiziga bitwaye abarwayui, inkomere n'abaganga bahurujwe; Ibin,yabiziga ndakumirwa; Ibinyabiziga bitwaye umuntu ufite uburenganzira bwo guhita mbere; Ibinyabiziga bitwaye ubutumwa bwanditse bifite ikimenyetso kibiranga; Ibinyabiziga bitwaye amatungo

entries.q: Ni nde (bande) bemerewe kujya mu kunyabiziga igihe gishyirwa mu cyome (kiva mu cyome)? 40.4
entries.a: uretse abayobozi n'abagiherekeje, abantu bose bagomba kuvamo

entries.q: Umuyobozi w'imodoka agomba gukora iki mbere yo kuyishyira mu cyome na mbere yo kuyikuramo ageze ku nkombe yo hakurya ? 40.5
entries.a: Agomba kumanura ibirahure

entries.q: Ibyerekeranye N'amatara Ndanga
entries.a: Iyo bwije kugeza bukeye cg bitewe n'ihe cy'ibihu, imvura nyisnhi bitagishoboka kubona muri 200 m ukuba mu nzira nyabagendwa kugomba kugaragazwa muri ubu buryo :; Velomoteri, moto (bidafite akanyamitende kuruhande, bifite umuyobozi kandi bifite bateri),: imbere ; Itara rimwe ryera cg umuhondo cg risa nicunga ihishije ; Inyuma : Itara rimwe ritukura (ndanga nyuma); Ibindi binyabiziga bigendeshwa na moteri, : inyuma : Amatara abiri atukura (ndanganyuma); Imodoka zikuruwe n'inyamaswa, ingorofani, inyamaswa zitwaye imizigo ........... (cfr art 42.1.d); A revoir l'article

entries.q: Ni ryali amatara magufi, amatara ndanga n'amaremare bicanirwa rimwe ? 43.1
entries.a: Iyo hagati yo kurenga no kurasa kw'izuba cg bitewe bitewe n'uko ibihe byifashe, nk'igihe k'igihu cg cccy'imvura nyinshi, bidashobotse kubona neza muri 100 m.

entries.q: Amatara magufi n'amaremare bigomba kuzima ryali ? 43.2
entries.a: Iyo ikinyabiziga gihagaze umwanya muto cg umunini

entries.q: Amatara maremare y'ikinyabiziga agomba kuzimwa ryali ? 43.3
entries.a: Iyo umuhanda umulikiwe hose kuburyo buhagije; Iyo, ikinyabiziga kigiye kubisikana n'ikindi; Iyo ikinyabiziga gikurikiye ikindi mu ntabwe zitarenze 50m, keretse iyo ashaka kunyura kucyo akurikiye; Iyo ikinyabiziga gihagaze

entries.q: Amatara magufi y'amapikipiki na za velomoteri agomba gukoreshwa ryali ? 43.4
entries.a: Igihe cyose bigenda mu nzira nyabagendwa

entries.q: Amatara kamenabihu akoreshwa ryali ? 43.5
entries.a: Akoreshwa gusa iyo imiterere y'ikirere (imvura, ibihu) gituma ntawe ubona neza nko muri 100m, iyo ikinyabiziga kigenda mu nzira nyabagendwa ifunganye irimo amakoniS

entries.q: Amatara yo gusubira inyuma acanwa ryali? 43.7
entries.a: Igihe cyo gusubira inyuma gusa

entries.q: Amatara ashakisha acanwa ryali? 43.8
entries.a: igihe ari ngombwa kandi atabangamiye abandi bagenzi

entries.q: Ni ryali gukoresha amahoni ari ngombwa ? Bimara umwanya ungana ute ? 47.2
entries.a: Igihe hari impamvu yo kwirinda impanuka, cyangwa igihe atari mu nsisiro, kugira ngo umuyoboei uri imbere amenyeshwe ko bagiye kumunyuraho.; Bigomba kumara umwanya muto

entries.q: Ese biremewe kuvuza ihoni ahegereye amatungo cg inyamaswa ? 47.5
entries.a: OYA

entries.q: Abanyamaguru bagenda mu muhanda nijoro, hatabona cg hari ibinyabiziga byinshi bagenda bate? 48.5
entries.a: Bagenda ku murongo

entries.q: Hagati y'ibinyabiziga biherekeranije mu butumwa hagomba kubamo umwanya ungana ute ? 49.1
entries.a: Hagomba kuba byibura 30m; Ibinyabiziga biherekerenije mu butumwa ntibishobora gutonda uburebure urenga umurongo wa 500 m. iyo bibaye bityo ibinyabiziga bishobora kugabanywamo amatsinda atonze umurongo atarengeje 500 m z'uburebure kandi hagati yayo hakaba byibura 50m.

entries.q: Ni ryali ibinyabiziga bya gisilikare biherekeranije mu butumwa bitubahiriza amategeko agenga imodoka ziherekeranije mubutumwa ? Art 49.1
entries.a: Mu nsisiro; Kuva bwije kugeza bukeye; Igihe igihu cyabuditse bigatuma badashobora kureba neza muri 30m byibura

entries.q: Umubare w'inyamaswa zikurura ikinyabiziga ni zingahe ? art 51.1
entries.a: 4 iyo zikurikiranye; 3 iyo zibangikanye

entries.q: Ubugari bw'ikinyabiziaga cg ibinyabiziga bikururana nibirenze ku mubyimba wabyo hatabariwemo amatara yerekana ikerekezo n'indorerwamo ziboneshsa ntibishobora kurenza uruhe rugero? 57.1
entries.a: 2,65 m, ubutambike butambitse uwo ari bwo bwose, ariko

entries.q: Ubugari ntarengwa bwa romoroki ikuruwe n'ipikipiki, igare cg velomoteri ni ubuhe? 57.1.a et b
entries.a: 75 cm iyo ikuruwe n'igare cg velomoteri; 1,25 m iyo ikuruwe n'ipikipiki idafite akanyabiziga kometse ku ruhande.

entries.q: Ni ubuhe bugari ntarengwa bwa romoroki ikuruwe n'ipikipiki ifite akanyabiziga kometse ku ruhande rwayo, cg iyo ikuruwe n'ikinyamitende itatu cg ine, gifite cg kidafite moteur? 57.1.c
entries.a: Ni ubugari bw'ikinyabiziga gikurura

entries.q: Ni ubuhe bugali ntarengwa bw'inyabiziga bihiinga, bitarenza umuvuduko wa 20km/h iyo bijya cg biva mu murima? 57.1.c
entries.a: 3 m

entries.q: Ni ibihe binyabiziga bigira uburebure ntarengwa bwa 7 m? 57.2.a
entries.a: Ibinyabiziga cg ibinyabiziga bikururana bifite umutambiko umwe uhuza imipira;; Ibinyabiziga bifite imitambiko ibiri yihindukiza kucyo ifundiyeho; Ibinyabiziga bifite imitambiko ibiri ifite ikiyihuza, imitambiko ikoranye (hagati ntiharenze 1,60 m

entries.q: Ni ibihe binyabiziga bigira uburebure ntarengwa bwa 11m? 57.2.B
entries.a: Ibinyabiziga bifite imitambiko ibiri cg irenga

entries.q: Igice kirenga ku biziga (kirenga ku mapine): porte faux:
entries.a: Igice kirenga imbere: 2,70 m; Igice kirenga inyuma: 3,50m

entries.q: Uburebure buri hagati y'imipira y'inyuma n'iyimbere n'uburebure bw'ibice by'imbere n'iyinyuma y'imipira ku binyabiziga bifite imitambiko irenga ibiri bupimwa bahereye ku ki? 57.4.
entries.a: Bupimwa bahereye hagati y'imipira iteganye

entries.q: Ni mu buhe buryo imizigo ipakiye mu kinyabiziga igomba gupakirwa no gupangwa? 60.1
entries.a: Ipakirwa ndetse igapangwa ku buryo idashobora:; Guteza abantu ibyago; Kwangiza murugendo inzira nyabagendwa; Kubuza umuyobozi kubona neza; Guingiriza amatara, ururebanyuma two hanze, utugarura rumuri plaque; Igomba kandi gupangwa no kuzirikwa ku modoka

entries.q: Iyo imizigo irenga impera y'imyuma y'iknyabiziga ho 1 m, igice cy'imyuma y'iknyabizigo kigomba kugaragazwa n'iki? 63.
entries.a: Ku manywa: agatambaro gatukura gafite byibura 50 cm z'uruhande; Nijoro (iyo amatara y'ikinyabiziga agomba gucanwa): itara cg akagarura - rumuri bitukura

entries.q: Mu mijyi ndetse ,o mumihanda y'igihugu, ubwikorezi ntarengwa bwemewe kuri buri mutambiko ufungwaho ibiziga bine buzaba: (67.1.A)
entries.a: Kuri buri mutambiko usanzwe : 10 tones; Ku mitambiko ibiri ikurikiranye: 16 tons; Ku mitambiko itatu ikurikiranye: 24 tones;; Ikamyo iyo ari yo yose ntishobora na rimwe gutwara ibintu birenze 53 tones.; NB. Uburemere ntarengwa, subira muri journal officiel usonme art 67 yose ni ya 68.

entries.q: Iyo hagati y'uruhande rw'imbere rwa romororki n'uruhande rw'inyuma rw'ikinyabiziga kiyikururahari umwanya urenze 3m, ikibiziritse kigomba kugaragazwa n'iki? 71.1
entries.a: Ku manywa: Agatambaro gatukura gafite nibura 50cm; Nijoro (iya amatara y'ikinyabiziga agomba gucanwa): itarara ria n'icunga rihishije; keretse iyo ikibizirikanije kimuritswe.

entries.q: Ibizirikisho by'iminyururu cg by'insinga kimwe n'ibindi bizirikisho by'ingoboka bikoreshwa ryari? Kubera iyihe mpamvu? 71.2
entries.a: Bikoreshwa gusa igihe nta kundi umuntu yabigenza; Nta kindi bigirirwa, uretse gusa kugira ngo ikinyabiziga kigere aho kigomba gukorerwa. ( ne pas depasser 20km /h)

entries.q: Ibyo bizirikisho bigaragazwa n'iki? 71.2
entries.a: N'icyapa cyera cya mpande enye zingana gifite nibura 30 cm kuri buri ruhande; gishyirwa kuruhande rw'imbere z'ikinyabiziga gikurura.

entries.q: obanura aya magambo:
entries.a: Ibiziga by'umutambiko (roues d'un esseiu): ni ibiziga biteganye cg bijya gusa n'ibiteganye, uhereye ku murongo ugabanya ikinyabiziga mo kabiri mu burebure. 73.1.a; Feri y'urugendo (frein de service): bivuga ubueyo busanzwe bukoreshwa kugirango ikinyabiziga kigende buhoro cg gihagarare (73.1.b); Feri yo guhagarara umwanya munini (frein de stationnement): Bivuga uburyo bukoreshwa ngo ikinyabiziga kigume hamwe mu gihe umuyobozi atakirimo. 73.1.c; Feri yop gutabara (frein de secours): Bivuga uburyo bukoreshwa kugirango ikinyabiziga kigende buhoro kandi gihagarare, igihe feri idakora neza. 74.1.d; Romoroki: Bivuga ikinyabiziga kigenewe gukururwa n'ikindi kinyabiziga 2.19 cg 74.1.e; Makuzungu (semi - remorque): bivuga romoroki yagenewe gufatishwa ku kinyabiziga gikurura kuburyo igice cyacyo kiba kikiryamyeho 2.20

entries.q: Amatara y'ibinyabiziga agomba kuba ateye kubuhe buryo? 75.1
entries.a: Ku buryo nta tara cg akagarurarumuri by'imbere y'ikinyabiziga bigaragara bitukura; Kuba nta tara cg akagarura - rumuri byera cg bisa n'umuhondo bigaragara ku ruhande rw'inyuma rw'ikinyabiziga, uretse itara ryo gusubira inyuma n'iriranga icyerekezo

entries.q: Amatara ashobora kurenga ibiri asa ku kinyabiziga ni ayahe? 75.3
entries.a: Itara ndanga mubyimba (ndangburumbarare); Itara ryerekana icyerekezo

entries.q: Utugarura rumuri tuba duteye dute? 75.5
entries.a: Imbere: Umweru; Inyuma: Umutuku; Utwo mu mbavu: Umuhondo cg icunga rihishije

entries.q: Umugenzi wese uri mu nzira agomba guhita akora iki?
entries.a: Guhita yumvira ibitegetswe n'abakozi babifitiye ububasha

entries.q: Ibitabo by'amashakiro byanditsemo numro z'ibinyabiziga ni : 6, bivuge. 121.1
entries.a: Ibitabo by'amashakiro y'ibinyabiziga by'abikorera ku giti cyabo; ... Iby'ambasade n'indi miryango ifite ubusonerwe n'abakozi bahakora; Iby'ubutegetsi bwa Leta, imishinga ya Leta, ibigo bya Leta; ..... Iby'ingabo z'igihugu; ...... Ibya polisi y'igihugu; ...... Ibyinjiye mu gihugu by'agateganyo

entries.a: Ibyinjijwe by'agateganyo n'abantu badasanzwe batuye mu Rwanda, ariko byambaye plaque yo hanze byujuje ibiteganywa n'amasezerano y'i Viyeni; Ibyinjijwe n'abasanzwe batuye mu Rwanda ariko, bikaba byujuje ibivuzwe haruguru, mu gihe kitarenze umwaka.

entries.a: Imbere : Mu nguni y'ibumoso; Inyuma : Hejuru mu nguni y'iburyo (32/30)

entries.q: Ibinyabiziga bigomba kwandikwaho amazina n'icumbi bya banyirabyo, ku buryo bugaragara imbere kuruhande rw'ibumoso ni ibi bikurikira : 131
entries.a: Ibinyabiziga bikururwa; Ibinyabiziga bisunikwa n'abantu; Ibinyabiziga bidasorerwa; Ibinyabiziga bigendeshwa na moteri byikorera ibio birenga 1.000 kandi bidatwara abantu gusa

entries.a: Ibinyabiziga bigenewe gutwara abantu muri rusange; Ibinyabiziga bigenewe gutwara ibintu birengeje 3,5 tones; Ibinyabiziga bigenewe ibigo byigisha gutwara ibinyabiziga; NB. Ibinyabiziga bisigaye, bikorerwa igenzura biri mwaka. 142. b.
