entries.a: Amategeko y'umuhanda; Prpar en vue d'obtention d'un permis de conduire au Rwanda; 1

entries.q: Sobanura ijambo: Inzira nyabagendwa.Ing.2
entries.a: Ni imbago zose z'imihanda minini, amabarabara, aho abantu nyamwinshi bahurira, aho imodoka nyinshi zihagarara, inzira n'utuyira two ku muhanda, ibiraro, ibyombo, muri rusange imihanda nyabagendwa igendwamo ku butaka.

entries.q: Sobanura ijambo: Umuhanda.
entries.a: Ni igice cy'inzira nyabagerwa kinyurwamo n'ibinyabiziga ikaba yagira imihanda myinshi.

entries.q: Sobanura ijambo: Inzira y'ibinyabiziga.
entries.a: Ni umuhanda n'inzira ziwukikije.

entries.q: Sobanura ijambo: Igisate cy'umuhanda.
entries.a: Kimwe mu bisate bigabanyije umuhanda mu burebure bwawo.

entries.q: Sobanura ijambo: Agahanda k'amagare.
entries.a: Igice cy'inzira nyabagerwa cyahariwe amagare na velomoteri kigaragazwa n'ikimenyetso cyabigenewe.

entries.q: Sobanura ijambo: Isangano.
entries.a: Ahantu hose imihanda ihurira

entries.q: Sobanura ijambo: Inkomane.
entries.a: Aho umuhanda wisukira mu wundi.

entries.q: Sobanura ijambo: Akayira.
entries.a: Inzira ifunganye yagenewe abanyamaguru, ibinyabiziga by'ibiziga bibiri.

entries.q: Sobanura ijambo: Inzira y'igitaka.
entries.a: Inzira nyabagerwa yagutse ariko itanyurwamo n'ibiziga bibiri.

entries.q: Sobanura ijambo: Urusisiro.
entries.a: Ahantu hari amazu yegeranye cg afatanye.

entries.q: Sobanura ijambo: Umuyobozi.
entries.a: Ni umuntu wese utwaye ikinyabiziga cg uyobora mu nzira nyabagerwa inyamaswa cg amatungo.

entries.q: Sobanura ijambo: Umukozi ubifitiye ububasha.
entries.a: Umukozi wambaye mu buryo bugarara imyenda iranga imirimo ashinzwe.

entries.q: Sobanura ijambo: Ikinyabiziga.
entries.a: Igikoresho cyose gikoreshwa mu gutwara ibintu n'abantu ku butaka, igihingishwa, gikoreshwa mu nganda n'ahandi.

entries.q: Sobanura ijambo: Ikinyamitende.
entries.a: Ikinyabiziga cyose kigendeshwa n'ingufu z'abantu nk'igare,...

entries.q: Sobanura ijambo: Igare.
entries.a: Ikinyamitende cyose cy'ibiziga bibiri

entries.q: Sobanura ijambo: Velomoteri.
entries.a: Ikinyabiziga gifite ibiziga bibiri kandi gifite moteri itarengeje imbaraga za KvA 4 n'umuvuduko ntarengwa ukaba 60km/h

entries.q: Sobanura ijambo: Ipikipiki.
entries.a: Ikinyabiziga cyose cy'ibiziga bibiri gifite moteri ukuyemo za velomoteri.

entries.q: Sobanura ijambo: Ikinyamitende itatu cg ine.
entries.a: Ibinyabiziga bifite moteri itarengeje KvA15

entries.q: Sobanura ijambo: Ikinyabiziga kigendeshwa na moteri.
entries.a: Ikinyabiziga cyose gifite moteri kandi kigendeshwa gusa n'ibikigize.

entries.q: Sobanura ijambo: Imodoka.
entries.a: Ikinyabiziga cyose kigendeshwa na moteri uretse za velomoteri, amapikipiki, imashini zihinga cg zikurura izindi.

entries.q: Sobanura ijambo: Romoroki.
entries.a: Ikinyabiziga cyose cyagenewe gukururwa.

entries.q: Sobanura ijambo: Makuzungu.
entries.a: Ni romoroki iyo ariyo yose ifatishwa ku kinyabiziga gikurura.

entries.q: Sobanura ijambo: Romoroki ntoya.
entries.a: Romoroki ifite ibiro bitarenga 750

entries.q: Sobanura ijambo: Ibinyabiziga bikomatanye cg ibinyabiziga bikururana.
entries.a: Ibinyabiziga bikomatanye bigenda nkaho ari kimwe.

entries.q: Sobanura ijambo: Ikinyabiziga gifanije.
entries.a: Ni ikinyabiziga gikomatanye kimwe ari ikinyabiziga ikindi ari makuzungu

entries.q: Sobanura ijambo: Ikinyabiziga gikururana kabiri.
entries.a: Ikinyabiziga gifatanije n'ikindi ari makuzungu.

entries.q: Sobanura ijambo: Uburemere bwite
entries.a: Uburemere bw'ikidapakiye.

entries.q: Sobanura ijambo: Uburemere bwikorewe
entries.a: Uburemere bwite hongewemo uburemere bw'imizigo.

entries.q: Sobanura ijambo: Uburemere ntaregwa bwemewe
entries.a: Uburemere bugendanwa.

entries.q: Sobanura ijambo: Guhagarara umwanya munini
entries.a: Igihe kiruta igihe ikinyabiziga giharara hinjiramo abantu cg ibintu.

entries.q: Sobanura ijambo: Guhagarara umwanya muto.
entries.a: Igihe ikinyabiziga giharara kugira ngo abantu bajyemo cg ibintu bijyemo.

entries.q: Sobanura ijambo: Akagarura rumuri. Ing.2(30)
entries.a: Akantu karabagirana gasubiza urumuri ku kirwohereje.

entries.q: Sobanura ijambo: Ikinyabiziga ndakumirwa
entries.a: Ibinyabiziga by'abapolisi, Ibizimya inkongi, Ibitwara abarwayi, aho bijya bigiye gutabara birangwa n'intabaza irabagira cg irangurura amajwi.

entries.q: Sobanura ijambo: Amatara y'urugendo. Ing.2(32)
entries.a: Amatara y'ikinyabiziga amurika imbere mu muhanda mu ntera ndende

entries.q: Sobanura ijambo: Amatara yo kubisikana .Ing.2(33)
entries.a: Amatara y'ikinyabiziga amurika inzira nyabagerwa atagobye guhuma ibinyabiziga bituruka imbere.

entries.q: Sobanura ijambo: Amatara ndangambere. Ing2(34)
entries.a: Amatara y'ikinyabiziga akiranga kandi agaragaza ubugari bwacyo burebewe imbere.

entries.q: Sobanura ijambo: Amatara ndanganyuma. Ing.2(35)
entries.a: Amatara y'ikinyabiziga akiranga kandi agaragaza ubugari bwacyo burebewe inyuma.

entries.q: Sobanura ijambo: Amatara kamena-bihu y'imbere.Ing.2(36)
entries.a: Amatara y'ikinyabiziga abonesha neza imbere yacyo mu gihe cy'igihu, cy'imvura nyinshi, cy'urubura cg cy'umukungugu.

entries.q: Sobanura ijambo: Amatara kamena-bihu y'inyuma.Ing.2(37)
entries.a: Amatara y'ikinyabiziga akiranga kandi yerekana ubugari bwacyo uburebeye inyuma, mu gihe cy'ibihu, cy'urubura cg mu bihe by'umukungugu.

entries.q: Sobanura ijambo: Amatara yo kubisikana..Ing.2(33)
entries.a: Amatara magufi.

entries.q: Sobanura ijambo: Amatara yo gusubira inyuma.Ing.2(38)
entries.a: Amatara abonesha inzira inyuma y'ikinyabiziga, akereka n'abandi ko icyo kinyabiziga kiri gusubira inyuma.

entries.q: Sobanura ijambo: Itara ndangacyerekezo. Ing.2(39)
entries.a: Cg ikinnyoteri, Itara ry'ikinyabiziga ryereka abandi bagenzi ko ikinyabiziga gishaka gukata.

entries.q: Sobanura ijambo: Itara rishakisha. Ing.2(40)
entries.a: Itara rihindukizwa rishobora kureba ikintu kiri no mu mpande zacyo.

entries.q: Sobanura ijambo: Itara ndangamubyimba. Ing.2(41)
entries.a: Itara ndangaburumbarare, itara ry'ikinyabiziga ryerekana ubugari bw'ikinyabiziga haba inyuma cg imbere.

entries.q: Sobanura ijambo: Ubuso bubonesha. Ing.2(42)
entries.a: Ubuso busohokana urumuri, cg ubuso burabagiranamo urumuri ku tugarurarumuri.

entries.q: Sobanura ijambo: Itara ry'umuhondo. Ing.2(43)
entries.a: Umuhondo wiganje, cg usa n'icunga rihishije cg umuhondo wiganje.

entries.q: Sobanura ijambo: Ukuboko kuzamuye k'umukozi ubifitiye ububasha kuvuga iki ?
entries.a: Kuvuga ko umugenzi wese agomba guhagarara keretse uwageze mu masangano ugomba guhita ahava.

entries.q: Sobanura ijambo: Ukuboko cg amaboko atambitse ategeka iki ?Ing.5(2b)
entries.a: Hategekwa guhagarara abaturuka mu cyerekezo gisanganya amaboko arambuye.

entries.q: Sobanura ijambo: Kuzunguza intambike itara ritukura bivuga iki ?
entries.a: Hahagarara abo iryo tara rireba.

entries.q: Vuga batanu mu bakozi babifitiye ububasha.Ing.3
entries.a: Ba ofosiye na ba suzofiye bo muri polisi y'igihugu bari mu kazi.; Ba kaporali na abapolisi bo muri Polisi y'igihugu igihe bari mu kazi.; Abapolisi bo mu mutwe ushinzwe umutekano mu muhanda.; Abakozi bo mu biro by'amateme.; Abakozi ba gasutamo.; Abakozi bo mu biro by'imisoro.; Abakozi b'ikigo cy'ubucyerarugendo.; Abakozi bo mu biro bya Ministeri ishinzwe gutwara ibintu n'ibintu babiherewe uburenganzira na Ministiri w'ubutabera.

entries.q: Vuga ibintu bitanu umugenzi wese uguweho n'impanuka asabwa ?Ing.4
entries.a: Guhita ahagarara niba bishoboka.; Gukora uko ashoboye kugirango badahungabanya uburyo bwo kugendera mu muhanda.; Kwirinda guhindura ibimenyetso,; Kumenyesha no gutumaho abubahiriza amahoro bari hafi aho.

entries.q: Ni ryari umuyobozi wese ategetswe kugaragaza umwirondoro we ? Ing.4(4)
entries.a: Iyo abandi bantu bahuye n'impanuka babimusabye.

entries.q: Ni ryari umuyobozi agomba guhita akuraho ikinyabiziga cye gihagaze umwanya munini cg muto ?
entries.a: Ni igihe abisabwe n'umukozi ubifitiye ububasha.

entries.q: Ni ryari umugenzi wese agomba kubahiriza ibimenyetso byashyiriweho gutunganya uburyo bwo kugenda mu muhanda ?Ing.5(5)
entries.a: Igihe bitunganijwe neza kandi bigaragara bihagije.

entries.q: Ibitegekwa birusha ibindi gukomera ni ibihe ?Ing.5(6)
entries.a: Ni ibitegekwa n'abakozi babifitiye ubushobozi.

entries.q: Vuga ikintu utagomba kwibagirwa igihe ugiye gutwara ikinyabiziga kigendeshwa na moteri?Ing.6(1)
entries.a: Ni uruhushya rwo gutwara icyo kinyabiziga.

entries.q: Izindi modoka zitaboneka muri izi nzego zibarirwa mu ruhe rwego ?
entries.a: Ni mu rwego rwa B.Ing.6(3)

entries.q: Ni ryari uruhushya rw'ibinyabiziga rutangwa burundu ?Ing.6(4)
entries.a: Ni igihe ubazwa azi amategeko y'umuhanda n'igihe ubazwa azi bihagije gutwara ikinyabiziga cyo mu rwego asabira uruhushya rwo gutwara.

entries.q: Uruhushya rw'agateganyo rufite agaciro ku zihe nzego ?
entries.a: Rufite agaciro ku nzego zose.

entries.q: Ni ryari ufite uruhushya rw'agateganyo ashobora gutwara ikinyabiziga ?
entries.a: Ni igihe ari kumwe n'umuyobozi ufite uruhushya rwo gutwara icyo kinyabiziga.

entries.q: Vuga ikintu kiranga ikinyabiziga kigirwaho.
entries.a: kirangwa n'inyuguti ya L yanditswe mu ibara ry'ubururu kandi n'uburebure butari hasi ya 15cm. Cg icyapa cy'umweru cyanditsweho " Auto-Ecole ".

entries.q: Iyo uruhushya rwo gutwara ikinyabiziga rutakaye rusimburwa n'iki ?Ing.6(6)
entries.a: Rusimburwa n'inyandiko yarwo mu minsi itarenga 15.

entries.q: Uruhushya rwo gutwara ibinyabiziga rwimwa cg rwamburwa nde ?
entries.a: Abantu barwaye amaso ku buryo bitakosorwa n'indorerwamo.; Abantu batumva n'izindi ndwara zabuza ingingo gukora neza.Ing.6(8)

entries.q: Iyo rwambuwe rwamburwa na nde kandi bigenda gute ?
entries.a: Rwamburwa na Prokireri wa Repubulika abonye icyemezo cya muganga wa Leta.Ing.6(8)

entries.q: Ni bande batagomba kugendana impushya zatangiwe mu Rwanda?Ing.6(9)
entries.a: Abantu bataramara umwaka mu Rwanda ariko bafite uruhushya mva mahanga rwemewe.

entries.q: Vuga ibintu bitanu bishobora kubangamira uburyo kugendera mu muhanda.Ing.8
entries.a: Kujugunya, kurunda, gusiga cg kugusha ibintu ibyo aribyo byose, nk'ibisate by'ibirahure, mazutu, lisansi, gazi, n'amavuta, kuka ibyotsi cg ikindi kintu cy'inkomyi.

entries.q: Uku kubangamira umuhanda byemerewe nde kandi ryari?
entries.a: Byemerewe ku bakozi b'imirimo ya Leta cg se abandi bantu bikorera babiherwe uruhushya.

entries.q: Ni iki umuyobozi agomba gukora igihe aguweho n'impanuka? Ing.8(2)
entries.a: Guhita atunganya umuhanda kugira ngo arinde impanuka ishobora guterwa na we yabinanirwa bigakorwa n'umuherekeje.

entries.q: Iyo umuyobozi atabishoboye bikorwa nande?
entries.a: Bikorwa n'umuherekeje.

entries.q: Vuga ibintu bitanu byonona inzira nyabagerwa?Ing.8(3)
entries.a: Kuvanaho, kwimura, guhirika cg gusenya imbago, ibimenyetso cg ibyapa biyiteyeho cg biyubatseho.

entries.q: Umuyobozi agomba gukora iki kugira ngo atangiza umuhanda?
entries.a: Kugabanya ibitwawe cg kunyura undi muhanda.

entries.q: Ni uruhe ruhande rugomba kugendwamo mu muhanda? Ni ryari agomba kwegera inkombe y'iburyo?
entries.a: Ni uruhande rw'iburyo. Agomba kwegera cyane uruhande rw'iburyo igihe agiye guhura n'undi cg undi agiye kumunyuraho.

entries.q: Inyamaswa zigenda mu muhanda zigendeshwa ku yihe nkombe?
entries.a: Zigendeshwa ku nkombe y'uruhande rw'iburyo.

entries.q: Ku muhanda ugabanyijemo ibisate bine bigendwamo gute?
entries.a: Umuyobozi agomba kugenda muri kimwe mu bisate bibiri by'iburyo.

entries.q: Ni ryari byemewe kugenda ku mirongo ibangikanye?
entries.a: Igihe umuhanda ugendwamo mu cyerekezo kimwe.

entries.q: Umuyobozi ugenda mu muhanda abujijwe kurengera iki?Ing.13(1)
entries.a: Kurengera inzira y'abanyamaguru.

entries.q: Ni ikihe kinyabiziga kibujijwe gukomeza kugenzwa mu muhanda? Ing.13(2)
entries.a: Igihe ikinyabiziga kirengeje metero 4 z'ubuhagarike habariwemo n'ibyikorewe.

entries.q: Hasigwa ubugari bungana iki iyo umuyobozi anyuze ku nkomyi?Ing.14
entries.a: Hasigwa metero imwe.

entries.q: Iyo bidashobotse umuyobozi agendera ku wuhe muvuduko?
entries.a: 5km/h

entries.q: Umuyobozi wese ugiye kugera mu nkomane akora iki?
entries.a: Agomba kugabanya umuvuduko byaba ngombwa akerekana ikimenyetso cy'uko ahageze.

entries.q: Umuyobozi wese uvuye mu nzira nyabagerwa ifite ibyerekezo bibiri akaba ashaka kwinjira mu yindi ategetswe iki? Ing.15(2)
entries.a: Areka ibindi biyigendamo bigatambuka.

entries.q: Umuyobozi wese uvuye mu muhanda utarimo kaburimbo ategetswe iki?
entries.a: Ategetswe kureka abagenda mu muhanda urimo kaburimbo bagatambuka.

entries.q: Umuyobozi wese uvuye mu kayira cg mu nzira y'igitaka ategetswe iki?
entries.a: Ategetswe kureka abandi bagatambuka.

entries.q: Umuyobozi wese uvuye ahantu hahana imbibi n'inzira nyabagerwa ategetswe iki?
entries.a: Ategetswe kureka abayigendamo bagatambuka.

entries.q: Umuyobozi ategetswe kureka binyabiziga bituruka mu kuhe kuboko gutambuka?Ing.16
entries.a: Mu kuboko kw'iburyo.

entries.q: Amategeko yo gutambuka mbere yerekanwa n'ibihe byapa?
entries.a: Ibimenyetso by'amatara n'ibindi byapa B1, B2b na A22

entries.q: Umuyobozi ugiye kugera mu masangano aho agomba kuzenguruka asabwa iki?Ing.16(2)
entries.a: Asabwa kureka abayigezemo bakabanza bakavamo.

entries.q: Umuyobozi wese ugeze mu masangano aho ibinyabiziga biyoborwa n'ibimenyetso by'umuriro asabwa iki?
entries.a: Agomba guhita avamo adategereje ko yemererwa ntawe abangamiye.

entries.q: Umuyobozi wese ushaka kugira aho agana asabwa iki?Ing.17
entries.a: Asabwa kubanza kumenya ko ntawe ari bubere inkomyi.

entries.q: Mbere yo gukata cg kujya ku ruhande rw'umuhanda umuyobozi asabwa iki?Ing.17
entries.a: Agomba mbere y'igihe kubigaragaza akoresheje amatara ndanga cyerekezo cg agakoresha ukuboko.

entries.q: Ni ryari ikimenyetso cyatanzwe kirekeraho gutangwa?
entries.a: Iyo imiyoborere irangiye.

entries.q: Abayobozi b'ibindi binyabiziga basabwa iki igihe bahuye n'ibinyabiziga bitwarira abantu hamwe?Ing.18
entries.a: Kugenda buhoro, byaba ngombwa bagahagarara akanya gato.

entries.q: Kubisikana bikorerwa he? Ing.20
entries.a: Bikorerwa iburyo.

entries.q: Umuyobozi wese ubisikana n'undi asabwa iki? Ing.20(2)
entries.a: Asabwa gusiga umwanya uhagije ibumoso bwe.

entries.q: Iyo ubugari bw'umuhanda budahagije ibisikanwa rikorwa rite?Ing.2(3)
entries.a: Abayobozi basabwa koroherana.

entries.q: Iyo umuhanda ucuramye cyane, aho ibisikana ridashoboka cg riruhije, bigenda bite?Ing.20(5)
entries.a: Umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga kimanuka ashyira ku ruhande ikinyabiziga cye, Iyo hagomba kugira abasubira inyuma, ni abatwaye ibinyabiziga bidakomatanye basubira inyuma, cg abatwaye ibinyabiziga bitwaye ibintu bihuye n'ibitwarira abantu hamwe.

entries.q: Kunyuranaho bikorerwa mu ruhe ruhande?Ing.21
entries.a: Bikorerwa mu ruhande rw'ibumoso.

entries.q: Ni ryari kunyuranaho bishobora gukorerwa iburyo?Ing.21
entries.a: Igihe uwo ushaka kunyuraho yagaragaje ko ashaka gukatira ibumoso ndetse yabitangiye.

entries.q: Vuga ibintu bine umuyobozi agomba kwiringira mbere yo kunyura ku wundi?Ing21(2)
entries.a: Agomba kwiringira:; Ko uwagiye kunyuraho na we atatangiye kunyura ku wundi cg atagiye gukatira ibumoso,; Ko nta wundi muyobozi watangiye kumunyuraho,; Ko igisate cy'umuhanda agiye kunyuramo kitarimo inkomyi,; Ko ashobora kugaruka mu muhanda atabangamiye mugenzi we, Kandi agomba kwerekana igikorwa agiye gukora.

entries.q: Umuyobozi ushaka kunyuranaho asiga intera ingana iki yitaza mugenzi we?Ing.21(3)
entries.a: Agomba gusiga umwanya uhagije ntujye munsi ya 50cm na 1m igihe agiye kunyura ku banyamaguru cg ku nyamaswa.

entries.q: Umuyobozi wese ugenda mu muhanda ashaka kunyuranaho igihe ubugari bwawo budahagije ashobora kunyura he? Ing.21(6)
entries.a: Ashobora kunyura mu nzira y'abanyamaguru amaze kwiringira ko ntawe ari buteze inkomyi.

entries.q: Umuyobozi ubonye ko hari undi ushaka kumunyuraho asabwa iki?Ing.21(6)
entries.a: Yegera ku buryo bushoboka bwose kwegera inkombe y'iburyo kandi akagabanya n'umuvuduko.

entries.q: Ni ryari umuyobozi asabwa kugenda buhoro byaba ngombwa agahagarara? Ing.21(6)
entries.a: Iyo hari undi uri kumunyuraho kandi umuhanda ari muto anamurusha umuvuduko.

entries.q: Umuyobozi ufite ikinyabiziga kirenga m 8 asabwa iki iyo abonye ko hari undi ugiye kumunyuraho?Ing.21(6)
entries.a: Agomba kwerekana ko yabonye ko ugiye kumunyuraho.

entries.q: Umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga cyari gihageze asabwa iki mbere yo kongera kugenda?
entries.a: Arabanza akareka ibinyabiziga bigiye kumunyuraho bigahita cg ibigiye guhura nabyo bigahita.

entries.q: Ni ryari kunyuranaho ibumoso bibujijwe?Ing.22(2)
entries.a: Iyo uwo ugiye kunyuraho yerekanye ko agiye gukatira ibumoso.

entries.q: Kunyura ku binyabiziga bindi uretse icy'ibiziga bibiri bibujijwe ahantu hari ikihe cyapa?
entries.a: Dessin C13a

entries.q: Ni ryari umuhanda ushobora kugirwa icyerekezo kimwe?Ing.23(1)
entries.a: Igihe bifuza kongera umutekano mu muhanda.

entries.q: Icyerekezo kimwe gishyirwaho nande?
entries.a: Umukuru w'intara, haba ari mu gihugu cyose bigakorwa na Ministiri ushinzwe imirimo ya Leta.

entries.q: Umuyobozi wese ushaka gukata , kuva mu muhanda cg guhagarika ikinyabiziga cye ibumoso ategetswe iki?Ing.23(1)
entries.a: Agomba kugaragaza icyo ashaka gukora mbere.

entries.q: Iyo akatira iburyo abigenza ate Ing.23(1a)
entries.a: Iyo ashaka gukatira iburyo yegera uko bishobotse kose iburyo bw'umuhanda kandi akagabanya umuvuduko, kandi na none ashobora kwegera ibumoso igihe abonye aribyo byamworohera ariko abonye ko ntawatangiye kumunyuraho.

entries.q: Iyo akatira ibumoso abigenza ate?Ing.23(1b)
entries.a: Yegera uko bishobotse kose umurongo ugabanya umuhanda mo ibice bibiri mu burebure ariko atawugiye hejuru, kandi akagabanya umuvuduko, iyo ari umuhanda ufite icyerekezo kimwe yegera ibumoso.

entries.q: Mu guhindura icyerekezo umuyobozi asabwa ibiki? Asabwa kureka hagahita bande?Ing.23(3)
entries.a: Agomba kubigira abanje kugabanya umuvuduko.; Kandi agomba kureka ibinyabiziga n'abanyamaguru bari mu muhanda avuyemo bagahita. Nanone kandi areka abanyamaguru bashaka kwambuka bakabanza bakambuka yaba ari mu muhanda avuyemo cg uwajyamo.

entries.q: Umuvuduko w'ikinyabiziga uringanizwa hakurikijwe iki?Ing.26
entries.a: Biterwa n'uko ahantu hameze, imimerere y'ikirere, imimerere y'ikinyabiziga cg ibyo kikoreye ndetse n'ubwinshi bw'ibigendera mu muhanda.

entries.q: Gukacira feri cg kugabanya umuvuduko mu buryo budasanzwe byakwagiza iki?Ing.26(2)
entries.a: Bishobora kubangamira imigendere isanzwe y'ibindi binyabiziga.

entries.q: Abayobozi b'ibinyabiziga bifite moteri bageze hafi y'amatungo, inyamaswa zikorera cg zigenderwaho basabwa iki?Ing.28
entries.a: Basabwa kugenda buhoro, bakitaza byaba ngombwa bagahagarara.

entries.q: Erekana umuvuduko wa ngombwa ku bintu bikurikira:Ing.29 -- Amapikipiki n'imodoka zifite uburemere ntarengwa 350kg
entries.a: Umuvuduko wa 80km/h

entries.q: Erekana umuvuduko wa ngombwa ku bintu bikurikira:Ing.29 -- Imodoka zifite uburemere ntarengwa bwa 12500 n'ibitwarira abantu hamwe.
entries.a: Umuvuduko wa 60km/h

entries.q: Erekana umuvuduko wo mu nsisiro ku modoka zagenewe gutwara abantu.
entries.a: Imodoka zidashobora kurenza toni 5 n'izitwarira abantu hamwe ni umuvuduko wa 50km/h.

entries.q: Ibindi binyabiziga byose.Ing.29
entries.a: Ibindi ni 40km/h.

entries.q: Imizigo y'ikinyabiziga igomba gupangwa hakurikijwe iki? Ing.60
entries.a: Ku buryo idashobora kubangamira uburyo bwo kugendera mu muhanda busanzwe. Kubuza kubona neza imbere umuyobozi cg inyuma, gukingiriza amatara cg ibimenyetso by'ikinyabiziga.

entries.q: Ikinyabiziga cyose gifite uburemere ntarengwa bwemewe burenga toni 5 kigomba gushyirwaho iki?Ing.29(4)
entries.a: Bashyiraho icyapa cyerekana umuvuduko ntarengwa w'icyo kinyabiziga.

entries.q: Icyapa gishyirwa ku kinyabiziga kirengeje toni 5 gishyirwa he kandi kiba kumeze gite?Ing.29(5)
entries.a: Icyo cyapa kigomba gushyirwa inyuma mu ruhande rw'iburyo, kigira ubugari bwa 21cm kandi umuzenguruko ugomba kuba utukura.

entries.q: Ku binyabiziga by'ingabo z'igihugu ikimenyetso kiranga umuvuduko gishyirwa he?Ing.29(6)
entries.a: Gishyirwa inyuma ku ruhande rw'iburyo kimwe n'ikimaze kuvugwa.

entries.q: Ni iyihe Ministeri ishinzwe gushyiraho imivuduko ntarengwa?Ing.30
entries.a: Ni Ministeri ishinzwe imirimo ya Leta.

entries.q: Ni umwanya ungana iki usigwa hagati y'ibinyabiziga bikurikiranye? Kuki? Ing.31
entries.a: Ni intera yitaje kandi ihagije.

entries.q: Ku binyabiziga bikomatanye basiga umwanya ungana iki? Kuki?
entries.a: Agomba gusiga umwanya uhagije keretse igihe agiye kukinyuraho.

entries.q: Ni ryari gusiga umwanya uhagije hagati y'ibinyabiziga bikurikiranye atari ngombwa? Ing.31(3)
entries.a: Ni igihe kunyuranaho bibujijwe cg se igihe mu muhanda harimo ibinyabiziga byinshi.

entries.q: Ikinyabiziga cg inyamaswa bihagaze umwanya muto cg munini biba biri mu ruhe ruhande? Ing.32
entries.a: bigomba kuba biri mu ruhande rw'iburyo cg se bikaba ibumoso igihe umuhanda ufite icyerekezo kimwe.

entries.q: Ni ryari bishobora kuba mu rundi ruhande?
entries.a: Ni igihe umuhanda ufite icyerekezo kimwe.

entries.q: Ibinyabiziga bihagaze mu muhanda umwanya muto bihagarara bite? Kandi hehe?Ing.32(2)
entries.a: Bigomba gutonda umurongo bikurikiranye ku nkombe y'umuhanda.

entries.q: Igihe ntarengwa cyo guhagarika ikinyabiziga mu nzira nyabagerwa kingana iki?Ing.32(3)
entries.a: Ni iminsi 7.

entries.q: Ni iki umuyobozi agomba kwiringira mbere yo gusiga ikinyabiziga cye cg inyamaswa ze?Ing.32(4)
entries.a: Agomba kwiringira ko icyo kinyabiziga cye kitaza guteza impanuka kandi akiringira ko kitaza gukoreshwa n'undi.

entries.q: Mbere yo gukingura umuryango w'ikinyabiziga, kuva cg kujya mu kinyabiziga ugomba kwiringira iki?Ing.32(5)
entries.a: Kwiringira ko utaza kubera imbogamizi abandi bagenzi bari mu nzira nyabagerwa.

entries.q: Ni bihe binyabiziga bitari ngombwa kurangwa n'ikimenyetso igihe bihagaritswe mu muhanda?Ing.32(6)
entries.a: Ni velomoteri cg ipikipiki idafite akanyabiziga ku ruhande.

entries.q: Icyo kimenyetso kiba kiri he?Ing.32(6)
entries.a: Icyo kimenyetso kiba kiri ahantu hagaragarira buri wese.

entries.q: Ni ryari biba ngombwa gushyira ku kinyabiziga ikimenyetso kikiranga igihe gihagaritswe mu muhanda? Ing.32(6)
entries.a: Iyo abayobozi bakigana badashobora gupfa kumenya ko kibabereye imbogamizi. Cg se ari ahantu habujijwe guhagarara.

entries.q: Umwanya usigara hagati y'ibinyabiziga bibiri bihagaze umwanya munini ku ruhande rumwe rw'umuhanda ugomba kuba ungana ute mu nsisiro? Ahatari mu nsisiro?Ing.32(7)
entries.a: ni 5m mu nsisiro na 20m ahatari mu nsisiro.

entries.q: Vuga ahantu hatanu bibujijwe guhagarara umwanya muto cg munini.Ing.33
entries.a: Ku iteme, mu ikoni, ahari ibimenyetso bibibuzanya, munsi y'amateme, mu mpinga, mu muhanda ufite ubugari buto, hafi cyane y'ibimenyetso by'umuriro 2m, mu nzira z'abanyamaguru, mu ruhande ruteganye n'urwo ikindi kinyabiziga gihagazemo, mu nsisiro,...

entries.q: Vuga ahantu hatanu ikinyabiziga kibujijwe guhagarara akanya kanini. Ing.33(3)
entries.a: Ahantu hinjirwa n'ahasohokerwa n'abantu benshi,; Imbere y'amashuri cg ahagenewe imyidagaduro,; Hafi yaho binjirira mu duhanda tujya mu bibanza byatikanye n'uwo muhanda,; Ahantu abanyamaguru banyura ngo bakikire inkomyi,; Ahantu habuza uko bagera ahateganyijwe guhararamo,; Ahatagejeje muri 1m y'ikinyabiziga gihagaze umwanya muto cg munini,; Ahatagejeje muri 15m y'ikimenyetso kerekana aho ibinyabiziga bitwarira abantu hamwe bihagarara.; Mu muhanda urimo umurongo udacagaguye,; Mu muhanda wo hagati mu nzira igabanijwemo ibisate bitatu,...

entries.q: Erekana icyapa kigaragaza ahantu umuntu atagomba guhagarara akanya . Ing.34
entries.a: Dessin C20a cg C20b

entries.q: Iyo umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga adahari ikinyabiziga gikurwaho nande? Ibyangiritse birihwa nande? Ing.35
entries.a: Gikurwaho n'umukozi ubifitiye ububashaibyangirite bikarihwa na Leta, ariko cyaba cyari gihagaze nabi bikarihwa na nyiracyo..

entries.q: Amatara y'intabaza agira irihe bara? Ayo matara y'intabaza akoreshwa ryari?Ing.Ing.36(1)
entries.a: Ibara ry'ubururu, agakoreshwa igihe ikinyabiziga kiri mu butumwa bwihutirwa.

entries.q: Intabaza ndangurura majwi ikoreshwa gusa ryari? Ing.36
entries.a: Ikoreshwa gusa igihe ikinyabiziga kiri mu butumwa bwihutirwa.

entries.q: Iyo umugenzi ari mu nzira nyabagerwa asatiriwe n'ikinyabiziga ndakumirwa akora iki? Ing.37
entries.a: Agomba kugihigamira byaba na ngombwa agahagarara.

entries.q: Ni ayahe mategeko ibinyabiziga ndakumirwa bisabwa kubahiriza?Ing.37
entries.a: Abakozi babifitiye ububasha, Ibyapa biyobora (byerakana)n' Ibiburira)

entries.q: Ni ibihe bimenyetso ibinyabiziga ndakumirwa bisabwa byanze bikunze kubahiriza?
entries.a: Ibyapa biburira n'ibyapa biyobora.

entries.q: Imirongo yose y'ingabo n'agatsiko kose k'abanyamaguru bari mu muhanda bategetswe kugendera mu ruhe ruhande?Ing.38(1)
entries.a: Mu ruhande rw'iburyo.

entries.q: Abagendera mu nzira nyabagerwa babujijwe kwata ibiki? Ing.38(2)
entries.a: Umurongo w'abanyeshuri bashorewe na mwarimu,; Umurongo w'abasirikare,; Uruhererekane,

entries.q: Ni izihe nkomyi zidakurikizwa ku binyabiziga ndakumirwa?
entries.a: Imirongo imaze kuvugwa hejuru ku kibazo cya 151.

entries.q: Abashaka gusiganwa mu nzira nyabagerwa basabwa iki?Ing.39
entries.a: Kwishingira ibyakwangirika byose

entries.q: Uruhushya rw'amasiganwa rusabwa nde iyo amasiganwa abera mu karere kamwa? Mu ntara? Mu gihugu?
entries.a: Umuyobozi w'akarere, Umukuru w'intara. Ministiri ushinzwe ubutegetsi bw'igihugu.

entries.q: Abahabwa uru ruhushya babanza kuzuza ibiki?Ing.39(3)
entries.a: Kugira ubwishingizi bw'ibyakwangirika byose.

entries.q: Uburemere bwemewe bunyuzwa ku iteme bwerekanirwa hehe? N'iki? Ing.40
entries.a: Ubwo buremere bwerekanwa n'icyapa kiba kiri ku ntangiriro y'iryo teme ku buryo kibonwa neza.

entries.q: Ni ubuhe buremere bwemewe ku mateme y'ibiti? Ing.40(2)
entries.a: Ni toni 8.

entries.q: Ninde ushobora guhindura uburemere bunyura ku iteme ry'ibiti?
entries.a: Ni umukuru w'intara.

entries.q: Iyo abayobozi begereye ibyome babigenza gute?Ing.40(3)
entries.a: Bahagarara ku murongo umwe bashoreranye iburyo bw'umuhanda.

entries.q: Garagaza uko ibinyabiziga bitambuka mbere bikurikirana.Ing.40(3)
entries.a: Ibitwaye abarwayi,; Ibinyabiziga ndakumirwa,; Ufite icyemezo kimwanditseho cyo guhita mbere,; Ibitwaye ubutumwa bwandite bifite ikimenyetso kibiranga,; Ibitwaye amatungo.

entries.q: Ni bande basigara mu kinyabiziga iyo kigiye kwinjira mu cyome?Ing.40(4)
entries.a: Ni umuyobozi n'ugiherekeje.

entries.q: Iyo imodoka igiye kwinjira mu cyome umuyobozi akora iki?Ing.40(5)
entries.a: Umuyobozi agomba kumanura ibirahure.

entries.q: Ibyapa byerekana uburemere bw'ibijya mu cyome biba biri he?
entries.a: Biba biri ku nkombe y'icyo cyome.

entries.q: Ku binyabiziga bikurikira erekana uko iyo biri mu nzira nyabagendwa bitagishoboye kugenda uko bigaragazwa biri nko muri metero 200 hatabona neza:Ing.42 -- Ibinyamitende, velomoteri n'amapikipiki bidafite akanyabiziga ku ruhande;
entries.a: Imbere n'itara rimwe ryera cg ry'umuhondo naho inyuma ni itara ritukura.

entries.q: Iyo amatara yo ku muhanda adatuma ikinyabiziga gihagaze umwanya munini kitagaragara neza muri metero 100, umuyobozi akora iki?Ing.42(2)
entries.a: Bakoresha amatara ndanga mbere na ndanganyuma.

entries.q: Amatara ndangambere na ndanganyuma ashobora gusimburwa n'ayahe matara igihe ibinyabiziga bihagaze umwanya munini mu nsisiro kandi bibangikanye ku ruhande rumwe?Ing.42(3)
entries.a: Amatara yo guhagarara umwanya munini.

entries.q: Sobanura amoko y'amabara yo ku kibazo cya 165 imbere n'inyuma z'ikinyabiziga.
entries.a: Amatara yera imbere cg asa n'umuhondo; inyuma aba atukura.

entries.q: Hacanwa itara ryo ku ruhe ruhande iyo ikinyabiziga gihagaze ahantu umwanya munini kandi hatabona neza? Ing.42(3)
entries.a: Hacanwa amatara ari hafi y'umurongo ugabanya umuhanda mo kabiri mu burebure.

entries.q: Amatara ya kamenabihu akoreshwa iyo umuntu atabona neza muri metero zingahe?Ing.42(4)
entries.a: Muri 100m.

entries.q: Amatara magufi n'amatara maremare acanirwa rimwe n'ayahe matara? Acanwa ryari?Ing.43
entries.a: Acanirwa rimwe n'amatara ndanga hagati yo kurenga kw'izuba no kurasa kwaryo.

entries.q: Amatara magufi cg amaremare azinywa ryari?Ing.43(2)
entries.a: Iyo uhagaze yaba umwanya muto cg munini.

entries.q: Vuga ibihe bitatu amatara maremare agomba kuzinywa.Ing.43(3)
entries.a: Igihe ugiye guhura n'undi,; Igihe umuhanda umurikiwe hose,; Iyo ugiye kubisikana n'undi,; Iyo ikinyabiziga gikurikiye ikindi mu ntambwe zitagera kuri 50m keretse iyo ashaka kukinyuraho nibwo ashobora gucana azimya.

entries.q: Ni ibihe binyabiziga bigomba guhora bicanye amatara (magufi) igihe cyose no mu buryo bwose igihe bigenda? Ing.43(4)
entries.a: Ni velomoteri n'amapikipiki.

entries.q: Amatara kamena bihu y'ikinyabiziga akoreshwa gusa ryari? Ing.43(5)
entries.a: Igihe hatabona neza nko muri metero 100.

entries.q: Amatara kamena bihu ashobora gusimbura ayahe matara yandi?Ing.43(5)
entries.a: Amatara yo kubisikana cg amatara y'urugendo.

entries.q: Amatara yo kubisikana n'amatara y'urugendo acanirwa rimwe n'ayahe matara? Ing.43(6)
entries.a: Acanirwa rimwe n'amatara ndanga.

entries.q: Amatara yo gusubira inyuma acanwa gusa ryari? Ing.43(7)
entries.a: Igihe ikinyabiziga kigiye gusubira inyuma.

entries.q: Amatara ashakisha acanwa gusa ryari? Ing.43(8)
entries.a: Ni igihe ari ngombwa kandi atabangamiye abandi.

entries.q: Umuyobozi ushaka guhindukiza ikinyabiziga cye cg kukiganisha ku ruhande, abigaragariza muri metero zingana iki?Ing.44
entries.a: Muri metero 50 byibura.

entries.q: Ushaka kugabanya umuvuduko w'ikinyabiziga akora iki?Ing.45
entries.a: Acana amatara abyerekana cg agakoresha ukuboko.

entries.q: Iyo amatara yo guhagarara atagikora neza umuyobozi akoresha iki?Ing.45
entries.a: Akoresha ukuboko.

entries.q: Kuvuza amahoni bimara igihe kingana iki?Ing.47
entries.a: Bimara umwanya muto ushoboka.

entries.q: Amahoni akoreshwa gusa ryari? Ing.47
entries.a: Akoreshwa gusa ushaka kwirinda impanuka.

entries.q: Amahoni asimbuzwa iki iyo bwije? Ing.47
entries.a: Asimbuzwa gucana uzimya amatara magufi cg usimburanya amatara magufi n'amatara maremare.

entries.q: Iyo umuyobozi agiye kunyura ku wundi abyerekana ate? Ing.47
entries.a: Akoresha imburira zimurika.

entries.q: Ahegereye inyamaswa zikurura, izikoreye ibintu cg amatungo umuyobozi akora iki kubijyanye n'amahoni? Ing.47(5)
entries.a: Birabujijwe gukoresha amahoni.

entries.q: Abagenzi bicaye mu myanya irimo imikandara bakora iki?Ing.47bis
entries.a: Bagomba kurumanya neza imikandara.

entries.q: Utuyira turi ku mpande z'umuhanda n'inkengero zigiye hejuru bihariwe bande? Ing.48(1)
entries.a: Ni abanyamaguru.

entries.q: Abanyamaguru badahuje gahunda banyura he? Ing.48(2)
entries.a: Banyura ibumoso ku nkengero y'umuhanda.

entries.q: Iyo nta tuyira twabigenewe, abanyamaguru baca he? Kandi gute?
entries.a: Bashobora guca mu muhanda ariko bitonze.

entries.q: Iyo abanyamaguru bagenda nijoro bagenda gute? Ing.48(5)
entries.a: Bagenda bakurikiranye ibumoso bw'umuhanda iyo badafitanye gahunda.

entries.q: Abanyamaguru bagomba kwambukira mu myanya yabugenewe iyo iri muri metero zingahe?Ing.48(6)
entries.a: Iyo iri ahatageze muri 50m.

entries.q: Iyo ari mu nkomane kandi nta mwanya wateguriwe abanyamaguru, banyura he?
entries.a: Bambukira mu murongo wambukiranya iyo nkomane.

entries.q: Mbese abanyamaguru bategetswe kubahiriza amategeko atangwa n'abashinzwe umutekano mu muhanda? Ing.48(7)
entries.a: Cyane.

entries.q: Abantu batwaye utunyabiziga tw'abana, tw'abarwayi, utw'ibimuga bubahiriza ayahe mategeko? Ing.47(10)
entries.a: Amategeko y'abanyamaguru.

entries.q: Hagati y'imodoka ziherekeranije mu butumwa hagomba kuba hari umwanya ungana iki? Ing.49(1)
entries.a: Ni 30m.

entries.q: Ni ubuhe burebure ntarengwa bwemewe bw'ibinyabiziga biherekeranije mu butumwa?
entries.a: Ni 500m.

entries.q: Amatsinda y'ibinyabiziga biherekeranije mu butumwa atandukanywa n'intera ingana iki? Ing.49
entries.a: Ni 50m.

entries.q: Ni ku bihe binyabiziga amategeko agenga ibinyabiziga biherekeranije atubahirizwa?Kandi ryari?Ing.49
entries.a: Ku binyabiziga by'ingabo z'igihugu.

entries.q: Ikinyabiziga cya mbere mu bihjerekeranije kirangwa n'iki? Icya nyuma cyo kirangwa n'iki?Ing.49(2)
entries.a: Icya mbere ni "Attention Convoi" naho icya nyuma ni "Fin de Convoi".

entries.q: Amabwiriza agenga ibinyabiziga bya gisirikare biherekeranije ashyirwaho nande? Ing.49(2)
entries.a: Ni Ministiri w'ingabo z'igihugu.

entries.q: Ibinyabiziga bikururwa n'inyamaswa bigabanywamo amatsinda afite uburebure bungana iki? Ing.49(3)
entries.a: Uburebure butarengeje 500m.

entries.q: Umubare w'inyamaswa zikurura zikurikiranye ugomba kungana ute? Ungana ute iyo zibangikanye? Ing.51
entries.a: Zikurikiranye ntizirenga enye.; Zibangikanye ntizirenga eshatu.

entries.q: Ni ryari umuyobozi akenera umuherekeza? Ing.51(4,5)
entries.a: Iyo uburebure burenga 18m cg 12m y'imizigo gusa.

entries.q: Iyo umuyobozi w'akanyabiziga gasunikwa atarebaneza imbere abigenza ate? Ing.52(1)
entries.a: Agomba gukurura ikinyabiziga cye.

entries.q: Ingorofani zinyuzwa he mu nzira nyabagendwa?Ing.52(2)
entries.a: Ku nkengero yegutse.

entries.q: Vuga ibintu bine abayobozi b'amagare na velomoteri babujijwe gukora igihe babiyoboye? Ing.53 (1)(a)
entries.a: Kuyobora badafashe amahembe,; Badakandagiye ku birenge,; Bakurura inyamaswa,; Bakururwa,; Basunika, bakurura cg batwaye ibyabangamira imiyoborere y'ikinyabiziga.; Kunyura mu muhanda kandi hari agahanda kabo,; Kurenza umuvuduko wa 40km/h; Gukoresha andi mahoni atarayo byagenewe,; No kunyura hagati y'imirongo ibiri y'ibinyabiziga bibangikanye.

entries.q: Ni ryari abayobozi b'amagare na velomoteri bagenda bashoreranye aho kugenda babangikanye?
entries.a: Iyo nta kinyabiziga bagiye guhura nacyo kandi ari ku manywa.

entries.q: Ingofero zirinda impanuka zambarwa nabande? Ing.53(3)
entries.a: Zambarwa n'umuyobozi n'uhetswe.

entries.q: Niryari abayobozi b'amagare na velomoteri bubahiriza amategeko y'abanyamaguru? Ing.53(5)
entries.a: Iyo basunika ikinyabiziga cyabo ni ukuvuga igihe bayoboye ikinyabiziga batakicayeho.

entries.q: Ni hehe bibujijwe gukinagiza inyamaswa zikorera cg izo bagenderaho kimwe n'amatungo? Ing.55
entries.a: Mu nzira nyabagerwa mu nsisiro.

entries.q: Ni hehe bibujijwe kubyagiza inyamaswa zikurura, izikorera ibintu cg izi bagendaho?
entries.a: Ni mu nzira nyabagerwa.

entries.q: Erekana icyapa cy'ahantu hagewe kugendera amatungo. Ing.54(3)
entries.a: D7

entries.q: Erekana icyapa cyemerera gushyiramo abantu mu kinyabiziga. Ing.56 bis
Ikinyabiziga gihagarara he ugereranije n'icyapa kibimwemerera. Ing.56 bis
entries.a: Ku ntera itarenga 10m uvuye ku cyapa kibimwemera.

entries.q: Vuga uburebure bw'ikinyabiziga cg ibinyabiziga bikururana ntarengwa.
entries.a: Ni 7m

entries.q: Uburebure bwa makuzungu bugomba kungana iki? Ing.57(2)
Ubuhagarike bw'ikinyabiziga bugomba kungana iki? Ing.57(3)
entries.a: Ni 4,20m

entries.q: Erekana uko igice kirenga ku biziga kigomba kuba kingana imbere n'inyuma. Ing 57(4)
entries.a: Ni 3,50m inyuma na 2,70m imbere.

entries.q: Ninde utanga uburenganzira ku binyabiziga bifite uburumbarare burenga ubwemewe kugendera mu muhanda? Ing.59
entries.a: Ni Minisriri ushonzwe gutwara ibintu n'abantu.

entries.q: Imizigo y'ikinyabiziga igomba gupakirwa neza hirindwa ibiki? Byibura ibintu bitatu. Ing.60(1)
entries.a: Hirindwa guteza abantu ibyago mu rugendo,; Kwangiza inzira nyabagerwa, impande zayo, ibiyubatsweho...; Kubuza umuyobozi kibona neza,; Gukingiriza amatara, utureba nyuma, utugarura rumuri, numero, cg ibimesyetso umuyobozi yerekanisha intoki.

entries.q: Ni ubuhe burumbarare bw'ikinyabiziga ntarengwa habariwemo n'imizigo haba n'inyamaswa cg romoroki? Ing.61(1)
Ni ryari ikinyabiziga gishobora gupakira kugera ku burumbarare bwa metero 2,75.Ing.61(1.a)
entries.a: Ni igihe gipakiye ibinyampeke, ikawa, amakara, ibishara, ibyatsi cg ibishami cg ubwatsi bw'amatungo.

entries.q: Ni ryari uburumbarare bw'ibipakiwe bushobora kugera kuri metero 3?
entries.a: Ni igihe hapakiwe ibimaze kuvugwa haruguru ariko bijyanwa ahatarenga 25km.

entries.q: Ni ryari ubuhagarike bw'ibitwawe bushobora kurenga metero 4? Ing.61(3)
entries.a: Ni igihe byakiwe uruhushya.

entries.q: Ku mpera y'inyuma y'ikinyabiziga uburebure bw'imizigo ntarengwa bungana iki? Ing.62(1)
entries.a: Ni 3m.

entries.q: Iyo imizigo irenga ku kinyabiziga ho metero 1 babyerekanisha iki nijoro? Ku manywa? Ing.63 Ku buhe buhagarike ntarengwa? Ing.63
entries.a: Babyerekanisha agatambaro gatukura ka 50cm z'uruhande.; Ni ijoro hacanwa itara ritukura cg akagarura rumuri gatukura.Bishyirwa ahatarenze 1,55m z'ubuhagarike.

entries.q: Ubugari ntarengwa bw'imizigo yikorewe n'igare na velomoteri kimwe na romoroki zabyo bungana iki?Ing.64(1)
entries.a: Ni 75cm.

entries.q: Ubugari bw'imizigo yikorewe n'amapikipiki adafite akanyabiziga ndetse na romoroki yazo bungana iki?
entries.a: Ni 1,25m

entries.q: Ubugari ntarengwa bw'imizigo ku kinyamitende itatu n'ikinyamitende ine bugomba kungana iki?Ing.64(3)
Vuga aho imizigo yikorewe n'amagare na velomoteri n'amapikipiki itagomba kurenga haba inyuma cg imbere. Ing.65
entries.a: Ni 50cm inyuma, imbere ho ntiyarenga impera y'imbere y'ikinyabiziga.

entries.q: Umwanya w'umuyobozi w'ikinyamitende itatu cg ine bifite moteri ugomba kuba byibura ungana iki? Ing.66 (a)
entries.a: Ni 55cm.

entries.q: Ni ryari abana badafite imyaka 12 bemerewe kwicara mu myanya y'imbere y'ikinyabiziga? Ing.66(3)
entries.a: Ni igihe hatarimo indi myanya.

entries.q: Igare, velomoteri n'amapikipiki bitwara abantu bangana iki? Ing.66(5)
entries.a: Bangana n'umubare w'intebe yabyo.

entries.q: Ni ibihe binyabiziga byemerewe gutwara abantu hejuru muri karisori? Ing.66(6:c)
entries.a: Ni ibinyabiziga by'ingabo z'igihugu, Abapolisi, Abasukura imihanda n'Abazimya umuriro.

entries.q: Erekana icyapa kigaragaza uburemere ntarengwa ku binyabiziga. Ing.68
entries.a: Ni C7

entries.q: Amasaha ntarengwa yo kugenzura uburemere bw'ibipakiwe ni angahe? Ing.68(3)
entries.a: Ni amasaha 2.

entries.q: Ni uwuhe mubare ntarengwa w'ibinyabiziga ugomba gukururwa n'ikindi kinyabiziga gitwarwa na moteri cg inyamaswa? Ing.70(1)
entries.a: Ni bibiri.

entries.q: Ipikipiki ifite akanyabiziga ku ruhande ikurura romoki zingahe? Ing.70(1)
entries.a: Nta na kimwe.

entries.q: Ni ryari washyira mu muhanda ibinyabiziga bikururana birenze bitatu? Ing.70(2)
entries.a: Ni igihe hatanzwe uburenganzira na minisitiri ushinzwe gutwara ibintu n'abantu.

entries.q: Iyo hagati ya romoroki n'ikiyikurura hari metero zirenze eshatu bigenda gute? Ing.71(1)
entries.a: Ikibizirikanije kigaragazwa ku manywa n'agatambaro gatukura,; Ni ijoro ni amatara asa n'icunga rihishije mu mbavu.

entries.q: Ninde utanga uruhushya rwo gutwara ibintu birenga ibyateganyijwe? Ing.72(1)
entries.a: Ni Ministiri ushinzwe gutwara abantu n'ibintu.

entries.q: Uwasabye urwo ruhushya aruhabwa amaze kuzuza ibiki?Ing.72(4)
entries.a: Aruhabwa ari uko yemeye kwishyura indishyi cg amafaranga y'ingwate ashobora guturuka ku byakwangirika.

entries.q: Iyo umuyobozi yarenze ku mategeko yo gupakira akorerwa iki? Ing.73
entries.a: Agomba gupakurura yakwanga agahagarikwa burundu.

entries.q: Ijambo "Ibiziga by'umutambiko" bivuga iki? Ing.74
entries.a: Ni ibiziga biteganye uhereye ku murongo ugabanya ikinyabiziga mo kabiri.

entries.q: Ijambo "feri y'urugendo" bivuga iki? Ing.74
entries.a: Uburyo busanzwe bukoreshwa kugira ngo ikinyabiziga kigende buhoro cg ngo gihagarare.

entries.q: Ijambo "feri yo guhagarara umwanya munini" bivuga iki?Ing.74
entries.a: Ni uburyo busanzwe bukoreshwa kugira ngo ikinyabiziga kigume hamwe.

entries.q: Ijambo "feri yo gutabara" ivuga iki? Ing.74
entries.a: Ni uburyo bukoreshwa kugira ngo ikinyabiziga kigende buhoro cg gihagarare igihe feri y'urugendo idakora neza.

entries.q: Ijambo "Romoroki" rikoreshwa ryari? Ing.74(e)
entries.a: Ni ibinyabiziga bikururwa n'imodoka.

entries.q: Vuga amoko ya feri. Ing.74(3)
entries.a: Hari feri y'urugendo, feri yo gutabara na feri yo guhagarara umwanya munini.

entries.q: Ese Romoroki igomba kugira aya moko yose yaza feri? Ing.74(4)
entries.a: Igomba kuyagira.

entries.q: Iyo Romoroki icitse ihagarikwa n'iki?Ing.74(4.f)
entries.a: Feri yayo igomba kuba ikozwe ku buryo yihagarika igihe icitse.

entries.q: Ni ayahe matara yera cg y'umuhondo agomba kujya inyuma?Ing.75(1)
entries.a: Ni amatara yo gusubira inyuma gusa n'aranga icyerekezo.

entries.q: Amatara y'imbere agira ayahe mabara? Ing.75
entries.a: Ibara ry'umweru cg umuhondo.

entries.q: Amatara y'inyuma agomba kuba afite ayahe mabara?Ing.75
entries.a: Ni umutuku cg icunga rihishije.

entries.q: Ni ayahe matara agomba kurenga abiri ku kinyabiziga? Ing.75(3)
entries.a: Ni amatara ndanga mubyimba, ndangaburumbarare, cg ayerekana icyerekezo.

entries.q: Bigenda gute iyo ikinyabiziga gifite amatara abiri cg arenze abiri y'ubwoko bumwe? Ing.75(4)
entries.a: Agomba kugira imbaraga zingana kandi agashyirwa hamwe.

entries.q: Vuga amabara y'utugarura rumuri tw'ikinyabiziga imbere, inyuma no ku mpanda. Ing.75(5)
entries.a: Imbere ni umweru naho inyuma ni umutuku naho mu mbavu ni umuhondo cg icunga rihishije.

entries.q: Amatara cg utugarura rumuri agomba kuba ateye ku buhe buhagarike uvuye ku butaka? Ing.75(7)
entries.a: Ahatari munsi ya 40cm.

entries.q: Ni ryari amatara maremare cg amagufi atakira rimwe n'amatara ndanga? Ing.75(8.2)
entries.a: Igihe akoreshejwe nk' ibimenyetso bimurika ho imburira.

entries.q: Itara ndanga rishyirwa he ku kinyabiziga? Ing.76(a.3)
entries.a: Rishyirwa ahegereye inguni y'ibumoso.

entries.q: Ni ryari itara ryo guhagarara rishyirwa ku kinyabiziga? Ing.76(a.2)
entries.a: Ni igihe ingufu za moteri zirengeje 125cm3.

entries.q: Amatara maremare n'ayo kubisikana akoreshwa ryari? Ing.76(5)
entries.a: Ni igihe ikinyabiziga kidapakiye gishobora kurenza 20km/h.

entries.q: Ibinyamitende itatu agira amatara ndanga mbere angahe n'ndanga nyuma angahe? Ing.76(6)
entries.a: Amatara 2 ndanga mbere n'amatara 2 ndanga nyuma.

entries.q: Ni ryari hakoreshwa itara ribonesha icyapa kiranga numero z'ikinyabiziga? Ing.76(7)
entries.a: Ni igihe icyo kinyabiziga gifite icyo cyapa.

entries.q: Ni ryari Romoroki igomba kugira amatara nkay'ikiyikurura? Ing.76(8)
entries.a: Ni igihe iyo Romoroki itera imbogamizi amatara y'imodoka iyikurura.

entries.q: Ni ibihe binyabiziga bigira amatara ndangaburumbarare? Ing.76(8,b)
entries.a: Ni ibinyabiziga bifite ubugari burenga 2,10m.

entries.q: Itara ry'icyatsi riboneka ku matagisi risobanura iki? Ing.76(2,c)
entries.a: Ryerekana ko icyo kinyabiziga kitakodeshejwe.

entries.q: Itara ry'icyatsi riboneka kuri za romoroki rimaze iki kandi rishyirwa he? Ing.76(2,g)
entries.a: Umuyobozi arikoresha ashaka kwerekana ko yabonye ikimenyetso cy'ushaka kumunyuraho.

entries.q: Ni ibihe binyabiziga bidashyirwaho amatara yabugenewe? Ing.76(2,h)
entries.a: Ni ibinyabiziga bihinga n'ibindi bikoresho bikoreshwa n'abapataniye mirimo.

entries.q: Za Otobis zigenewe gutwara abanyeshuri zishobora gushyirwaho amatara asa ate? Kuki? Angahe inyuma n'imbere? Kandi yaka gute? Ing.76(2,i)
entries.a: Amatara asa n'icunga rihishije amyatsa, rimwe imbere, irindi inyuma. Yerekana ko Otobis igeze aho igomba guhagarara. Kandi akamurika muri 100m.

entries.q: Amatara ndaga yaba ay'inyuma cg imbere agaragarira mu ntera ingana ite nijoro igihe ijuru ricyeye? Ing.77(1)
entries.a: Ni mu ntera ya 300m..

entries.q: Ku matara y'inyuma ya za velomoteri n'ibinyamitende intera y'ayo matara ireshya ite? Ing.77(1)
entries.a: Ni mu ntera ya 100m.

entries.q: Utugarura rumuri tuboneka muri ntera ingana ite nijoro iyo tumuritswe? Ing.77(2)
entries.a: Ni mu ntera ya 150m.

entries.q: Utugarura rumuri tw'inyuma ha romoroki tugomba kugira iyihe shusho kandi tungana iki? Ing.77(2)
entries.a: Ni ishusho ya mpandeshatu ndinganire ya 15cm cg 20cm z'uruhande.

entries.q: Ni zihe romoroki zishyirwaho akagarurarumuri kamwe? Ing.77(2)
entries.a: Ni Romoroki zifite ubugari ntarengwa bwa 80cm ikuruwe n'ipikipiki.

entries.q: Amatara ndanga mbere na ndanga nyuma agomba kuba ku ntera ingana ite uvuye ku butaka? Ing.77(3)
entries.a: Kuri 40cm uvuye ku mpera z'ubugari z'ikinyabiziga.

entries.q: Ku bijyanye n'utugarura rumuri intera kuva ku butaka iba ireshya ite? Ing.77(4)
entries.a: Ni intera itarenze 1m uvuye ku butaka.

entries.q: Amatara ndanga burumbarare abonwa ku yihe ntera iyo ijuru ricyeye? Ing.77(5)
entries.a: Ni intera ya 200m.

entries.q: Amatara yo guhagarara umwanya munini yohereza imbere urumuri rusa rute cg inyuma?Ing.77(6)
entries.a: Imbere rusa n'umweru n'urutukura inyuma.

entries.q: Amatara maremare y'ibara ryera cg umuhondo agomba kumurika mu yihe ntera igihe ijoro ricyeye? Ing.78(1)
entries.a: Ni mu ntera ya 100m imbere y'ikinyabiziga.

entries.q: Ni ryari iyo ntera ireshya na metero 75? Ing.78(1)
entries.a: Ni igihe ikinyabiziga gifite moteri itarengeje ingufu za 125cm3.

entries.q: Amatara yo kubisikana abonekera mu ntera ireshya ite? Ing.78(2)
entries.a: Ni mu ntera ya 40m.

entries.q: Ni ryari iyo ntera ingana na metero 15? Ing.78(2)
entries.a: Ku kinyabiziga kitarengeje 125cm3.

entries.q: Itara ryo gusubira inyuma ryohereza urumuri mu ntera ireshya ite?
entries.a: Ni mu ntera ya 20m

entries.q: Itara ryo guhagarara rigomba kugaragarira muri metero zingahe nijoro? Ku manywa? Ing.79(1)
entries.a: Ni mu ntera ya 150m nijoro igihe ijuru ricyeye neza.; Ni mu ntera ya 20m ku manywa.

entries.q: Iyo ikinyabiziga gifite itara rimwe ryo guhagarara rishyirwa he? Ing.79(3)
entries.a: Rishyirwa ku murongo ugabanya ikiziga mo kabiri.

entries.q: Itara ryo guhagarara ryaka ryari? Ing.79(4)
entries.a: ryaka gusa igihe bakandagiye feri y'urugendo.

entries.q: Vuga amabara y'amatara ndangacyerekezo y'inyuma n'ay'imbere. Ing.80(1)
entries.a: Imbere ni umweru cg umuhondo naho unyuma agasa n'icunga rihishije n' umutuku.

entries.q: Amatara ndanga cyerekezo ashobora gufatanywa n'ayahe matara yandi? Ing.80(1)
entries.a: Yafatanywa n'amatara yo guhagarara.

entries.q: Amatara ndangacyerekezo agaragarira mu ntera ingana ite nijoro? Ku manywa? Ing.80(3)
entries.a: Ni mu ntera ya 150m nijoro na 20m ku manywa.

entries.q: Amatara ndangacyerekezo aba ahagana he uvuye ku butaka? Ing.80(4)
entries.a: Aba ahatari hejuru ya 1,90m uvuye ku butaka.

entries.q: Itara riranga nimero rigira irihe bara? Rigomba gutuma nimero zisomeka byibura mu ntera ingana iki igihe ijuru rikeye? Ing.81
entries.a: Ni umweru rikagaragarira byibura muri 20m ikinyabiziga gihagaze.

entries.q: Kuva bwije, umuyobozi w'inyamaswa zikurura cg zikorera ibintu zitaziritse yitwaza urumuri rusa rute? Kandi rumurika gute? Ing.82(2)
entries.a: Ni urumuri rw'umweru cg umuhondo rubonesha impande zose.

entries.q: Iyo umukumbi ugizwe n'amatungo maremare kandi arenze ane cg amatungo magufi arenze atandatu, umuyobozi abigenza ate ku bijyanye n'amatara? Ing.82(3)
entries.a: Imbere hajya itara ry'umweru naho inyuma itara ritukura.

entries.q: Ihoni rya velomoteri ryumvikanira mu ntera ireshya ite?Ing.83(1)
entries.a: Ni mu ntera ya 20m.

entries.q: Ihoni ry'ibinyabiziga bigendeshwa na moteri ryumvikanira mu ntera ingana iki? Ing.83(1) Ni ryari ryumvikanira mu ntera ya metero 50? Ing.83(1)
entries.a: Ni mu ntera ya 100m. Bikaba 50m igihe ikinyabiziga kitarenza 50km/h.

entries.q: Ni ibihe binyabiziga bigira amahoni adasanzwe? Ing.83(2)
entries.a: Ni ibinyabiziga ndakumirwa.

entries.q: Ni akahe kamaro k'uturebanyuma ku kinyabiziga? Ing.84
entries.a: Kureba inyuma ko nta kinyabiziga gishaka cg cyatangiye kumunyuraho.

entries.q: Ibirahuri by'ibinyabiziga bigomba kuba bikoze bite? Ing.85(1)(a)
entries.a: Bigomba kuba bikozwe ku buryo bimenetse ibyago byo gukomereka bitaba bikabije cyane.

entries.q: Ibirahure byo guhagarika umuyaga bigomba kuba bikozwe gute? Ing.85(1,b)
entries.a: Bigomba kuba bidacuya, bidahindura ibara ry'icyo urebeyemo kandi nabyo byameneka ugakomeza kugenda nta kibazo.

entries.q: Ku kinyabiziga cyose uretse amapikipiki hagomba uduhanagura ibirahure tungahe? Ing.85(3)
entries.a: Byibura kamwe ko guhanagurira umuyobozi ngo abone neza.

entries.q: Ni ryari gusakurisha moteri bibujijwe? Ing.86(3)
entries.a: Mu nsisiro ikinyabiziga gihagaze.

entries.q: Amano y'ibinyabiziga bifite moteri na velomoteri agomba byibura ku afite milimetero zingahe? Ni ryari ibi bitubahirizwa? Ing.87(1)
entries.a: Ni 1mm, ntibyubahirizwa igihe ikinyabiziga kidapakiye kandi kitarenza 25km/h.

entries.q: Ni ibihe binyabiziga bigira ibiranga umuvuduko? Ing.88(3)
entries.a: Ni ibinyabiziga birenza 40km/h.

entries.q: Ni izihe modoka zigira imikandara yo kwirinda impanuka? Ing.88(4)
entries.a: Ni imodoka zagenewe gutwara abantu batarenze 6 n'umuyobozi arimo.

entries.q: Vuga muri macye icyapa kiburira. Ing.88(5,a)
entries.a: Ni mpandeshatu ndinganire ya 40cm ifite umuzenguruko utukura.

entries.q: Vuga ibintu bitanu buri kinyabiziga kigomba kugira. Ing.88(5)
entries.a: Icyapa kiburira, udupfuko byibura 4, ibikwasi 4 bitifungura, umuti wo kwica microbe, muri macye ibyagufasha gutabara igihe habaye impanuka.

entries.q: Ni ryari ikinyabiziga gifite moteri gishobora kugenda mu muhanda moteri itaka cg vitesi idakora? Ing.88(9)
entries.a: Ni igihe gikuruwe n'ikindi kinyabiziga gifite moteri.

entries.q: Ibimenyetso bigenga uburyo bwo kugendera mu muhanda birimo ibyiciro bingahe? Ing.91(1)
entries.a: Ni bitatu:; Ibyapa, Ibimenyetso byo mu muhanda n'ibimenyetso bimurika.

entries.q: Nibihe birusha ibindi agaciro hagati y'ibimenyetso by'amatara n'ibyapa? Ing.91(2)
entries.a: Ni iby'amatara.

entries.q: Ishyirwaho ry'ibimenyetso bigengwa nande? Ing.91(4)
entries.a: Bigenwa na Minisistiri ushinzwe gutwara ibintu n'abantu ku mihanda y'igihugu, n'umukuru w'intara mu ntara, na njyanama y'akarere mu karere.

entries.q: Ibyapa byo ku muhanda birimo amoko angahe?Ing.92(1)
entries.a: Birimo amoko 4:; Ibyapa byo gutambuka mbere,; Ibyapa biburira,; Ibyapa bibuza cg bitegeka,; Ibyapa ndanga.

entries.q: Ibyapa byo ku muhanda bishingwa mu kuhe kuboko? Ku buhe burebure?Ing.92(2)
entries.a: Bishingwa ku ruhande rw'iburyo bw'umuhanda.; Umusozo wo hasi ntube hasi ya 1,50m naho uwo hejuru nturenge 2,10m uretse ibyapa by'agateganyo.

entries.q: Ibyapa biburira bibereyeho iki? Ing.93(1)
entries.a: Kumenyesha icyago n'imiterere yacyo kandi bikanamutegeka ubwitonzi.

entries.q: Erekana ibyapa biburira n'ibyapa byo gutambuka mbere. Ing.93(2)
entries.a: Bishushanyije kuri mpandeshatu ndinganire izengurutswe n'ibara ritukura uretse bicye.

entries.q: Ibyapa biburira bishyirwa ku yihe ntera ahatari mu nsisiro?Ing.94(2)
entries.a: Bishyirwa mu ntera ya 150m kugeza kuri 200m yaho icyago kiri.

entries.q: Mu nsisiro ibyapa biburira bishyirwa he? Ing.94(5)
entries.a: Bishyirwa iruhande neza y'ahantu habi.

entries.q: Ibyapa byeraka abagenda ibyo babujijwe biba bimeze bite? Vuga n'amabara yabyo Ing.97(1)
entries.a: Biba bishushanyije ku ngasire izengurutswe n'ibara ritukura kandi ubuso bwera. Keretse ibibuza guhagarara umwanya muto cg umunini bigira ubuso bw'ubururu.

entries.q: Ibyapa bibuza n'ibitegeka bikurikizwa kugeza hehe? Ing.98
entries.a: Hagati y'inkomane naho icyapa gishinze.

entries.q: Ibyapa bibuza bishyirwa ku ruhe ruhande? Ing. 99
entries.a: Bishyirwa ahantu hagaragarira buri wese iburyo ndetse byaba ngombwa ikindi bisa kigashyirwa ibumoso.

entries.q: Erekana icyapa kemerera guhagarara umwanya munini. Ing.99(2)
entries.a: C20a na C20b

entries.q: Ibibuzwa ntarengwa bishobora gushyirwa ku ngasire imwe bingana iki?Ing.101
entries.a: Ntibigomba kurenga bitatu.

entries.q: Ibyapa bitegeka bishyirwa he? Ing.102
entries.a: Bishyirwa aharushijeho kubona neza.

entries.q: Ibyapa biyobora bishyirwa he? Ing.103
entries.a: Bishyirwa ahantu haboneye kurusha ahandi bitewe n'icyo byerekana.

entries.q: Iyo amatara atukura n'ay'icyatsi yakiye rimwe biba bivuga iki? Ing.104(5)
entries.a: Bisobanura kimwe n'amatara atatu.

entries.q: Iyo ibimenyetso bimurika bidakora abagenzi babigenza gute? Ing.104(6)
entries.a: Bubahiriza amategeko yo gutambuka mbere.

entries.q: Iyo hakomeje kwaka itara ritukura abagenzi rireba babigenza gute? Ing.104(7)
entries.a: Bashora gutambuka ariko barebye ko ntawe babangamiye.

entries.q: Itara ry'icyatsi rishyirwa ugereranije n'iry'umutuku? Ing.105(1)
entries.a: Rishyirwa hasi y'iritukura.

entries.q: Itara ry'umuhondo rishyirwa ugereranije n'itara ritukura cg iry'icyatsi? Ing.105(1)
entries.a: Rishyirwa hagati y'iritukura n'icyatsi.

entries.q: Amatara y'inyongera agizwe n'akaranga cyerekezo k'icyatsi ashyirwa he? Ing.105(1)
entries.a: Munsi cg iruhande rw'itara ry'icyatsi.

entries.q: Kurikiranya amatara y'ibimenyetso bimurika uko akurikirana mu kwaka. Ing.105(2)
entries.a: Habanza iritukura, icyatsi hanyuma umuhondo.

entries.q: Amatara y'ibimenyetso bimurika ashyirwa ku buhe buhagarike, agira izihe ngero z'ubuso? Ing.105(3)
Ibimenyetso bimurika bishyirwa mu ruhe ruhande rw'umuhanda? Ing.106(1)
entries.a: Bishyirwa iburyo bw'umuhanda ukurikije icyerekezo.

entries.q: Kugira ngo berekane ahantu habi bakoresha ikihe kimenyetso mu by'amatara? Ing.107(1)
entries.a: Bakoresha itara ry'umuhondo rimyatsa.

entries.q: Imbibi ziri ku muhanda zisigwa irihe bara? Ing.108(1)
entries.a: Ni ibara ry'umuhondo ngarurarumuri.

entries.q: Ibikoresho ngarura rumuri bishyirwa ku muhanda biba bisa bite ugereranije n'amerekezo y'umuhanda? Ing.108(2)
entries.a: Iburyo ni umutuku cg icunga rihishije naho ibumoso ni umweru.

entries.q: Vuga amoko y'imirongo y'ibimenyetso biri mu muhanda. Ing.110(1) -- Umurongo wera udacagaguye;
entries.a: Bivuga ko umuyobozi abujijwe kuwurenga, kandi ntawe ugomba kugendera ibumoso bwawo iyo uwo murongo utandukanya ibyerekezo byombi.

entries.q: Umurongo wera ukomeje n'umurongo wera ucagaguye bibangikanye umuyobozi yakwita ku wuhe? Ing.110(4)
entries.a: Yita ku murongo urushijeho kumwegera.

entries.q: Agahanda k'amagare kaba kameze gute? Ing.110(6)
entries.a: Kagaragazwa n'imirongo ibiri yera icagaguye ibangikanye ifite ubugari budahagije kugira ngo imodoka zitambuke neza.

entries.q: Ni uwuhe murongo ugaragaza ko guhagarara umwanya munini bibujijwe ku burebure bw'umurongo? Ing.110(8)
entries.a: Ni umurongo w'umuhondo ucagaguye uciye ku nkengero y'umuhanda.

entries.q: Umurongo mugari wera udacagaguye ugaragaza iki? Ing.110(9)
entries.a: Ugaragaza inkombe mpimbano y'umuhanda

entries.q: Igice cy'umuhanda kiri hakurya y'umurongo wera mugari cyagenewe iki?Ing.110(9)
entries.a: Icyo gice cyagenewe guhagararwamo umwanya muto cg munini.

entries.q: Ni iki kigaragaza umwanya ibinyabiziga bigomba guhagararamo? Ing.110(9)
entries.a: Ni imirongo yera yambukiranya umuhanda.

entries.q: Vuga ubugari bw'imirongo iromboreje cg itaromboreje. Ing.110(10)
entries.a: Ni 10cm kugera kuri 15cm.

entries.q: Imirongo yera iromboreje n'icagaguye ishobora gusimburwa n'iki mu muhanda? Ing.110(11,b)
entries.a: Ishobora gusimburwa n'imitemeri.

entries.q: Umurongo mugari wera udacagaguye uciye ku buryo bugororotse ku nkengero y'umuhanda uvuga iki? Ing.111(1)
entries.a: Werekana aho bagomba guhagarara akanya gato gategetswe n'icyapa (STOP) cg ikimenyetso kimurika cyerekana uburyo bwo kugenda mu muhanda.

entries.q: Umurongo ugizwe na mpandeshatu nyampanga uciye ku nkengero y'umuhanda mu buryo bugororotse uvuga iki? Ing.111(2)
entries.a: Werekana aho bagomba guhagarara akanya gato iyo bishoboka ngo batange inzira babyeretswe n'icyapa B1.

entries.q: Imirongo yera iteganye n'umurongo ugabanya umuhanda mo kabiri ivuga iki? Ing.111(3)
entries.a: Yerekana inzira abanyamaguru bagomba kwambukiramo.

entries.q: Imirongo ibiri icagaguye igizwe na kare cg ingirwamwashi by'ibara ryera isobanura iki? Ing.111(4)
entries.a: Isobanura akayira abanyamagere bashobora gucamo bambukiranya umuhanda.

entries.q: Imirongo yera yambukiranya umuhanda igomba kuba ifite ubugari bungana iki? Ing.111(5)
entries.a: Igomba kugira hagati ya 20cm na 60cm.

entries.q: Uturangacyerekezo n'ibyanditswe mu muhanda bigomba kugira byibura uburebure bungana iki? Ing.112(6)
entries.a: Bugomba kugira byibura 2,50m z'uburebure n'ubugari bwa 10cm na 30cm.

entries.q: Imirongo iberamye iteganye yera isobanura iki? Igira ubugari bungana iki? Kandi itandukanywa n'intera ingana iki? Ing.112(7)
entries.a: Yerekana icyerekezo iki n'iki kigomba kunyurwamo, iyo mirongo igira ubugari buri hagati ya 10cm na 15cm itandukanijwe na 20cm kugeza kuri 30cm.

entries.q: Ibimenyetso by'inkomyi bishyirwaho nande? Ing.113(2)
entries.a: Bishyirwaho n'uwateje iyo nkomyi, yaba itaturutse ku muntu igashyirwaho n'ubutegetsi bubishinzwe.

entries.q: Iyo hari imirimo iri gukorerwa ku muhanda hakoreshwa iki nijoro ? Ku manywa? Ing.114(1,a,b)
entries.a: Ni joro bakoresha amatara y'umutuku ku mpande zambukiranya umuhanda, akaba yera ku burebure bw'umuhanda.; Ku manywa babigaragaza bashyiraho udutambaro dutukura twa kare ya 50cm z'uruhande.

entries.q: Erekana icyapa kerekana imirimo irimo gukorerwa mu muhanda. Ing.114(1,b)
entries.a: Ikimenyetso A15.

entries.q: Ni iki kikubwira ko ugiye kwegera ahakorerwa imirimo mu muhanda? Ko uhageze? Ing.114(2.a)
entries.a: Ukiri kure ni ikimenyetso A15, waba uhageze bikagaragazwa n'uruzitiro ruri ku mpera zombi.

entries.q: Erekana icyapa cyo kuyobya umuhanda. Ing.114(2.e)
entries.a: Icyapa cyanditsweho dviation: E5c.

entries.q: Ni mu yihe ntera byibura ibyapa bigomba kugaragariramo n'ijoro igihe ijuru ricyeye? Ing.114(4)
entries.a: Ni mu ntera ya 100m.

entries.q: Ni ayahe matara abujijwe kumurikishwa ku byapa byamamaza? Ing.118
entries.a: Ni amatara afite ibara ry'icyatsi, umutuku iyo ari ahantu ha 75m uvuye ku bimenyetso bimurika.

entries.q: Vuga bitatu mu bitabo bitandatu by'amashakiro. Ing.121(1)
entries.a: 1. Abikorera ku giti cyabo,; 2. Ingabo z'igihugu,; 3. Ibigo bya Leta,; 4. Ibyinjijwe by'agateganyo,; 5. Ibya Polisi y'igihugu,; 6. Ibinyabiziga bya sa Ambasade.

entries.q: Ni ibihe binyabiziga bitagomba guhabwa numero zo mu Rwanda? Ing.122(2)
entries.a: Ni ibinyabiziga bitaramara umwaka mu Rwanda cg byinjijwe mu Rwanda n'abantu badasanzwe kandi bifite numero ibiranga yemewe n'amasezerano y'i Viyeni ya Le 08/11/1968.

entries.q: Vuga ibinyabiziga bihabwa numero n'ubutegetsi bubigenga. Ing.123(B)
entries.a: Ni ibinyabiziga by'ingabo z'igihugu n'iby'ubutegetsi n'ibigo byigenga.

entries.q: Ikarita y'umuhondo ihabwa ibihe binyabiziga? Ing.124(1)
entries.a: Ihabwa ibinyabiziga by'abikorera ku giti cyabo, iz' Ambasade cg imiryango ifite ubusonerwe.

entries.q: Ibimenyetso n'amabara biranga ibyapa bya polisi n'ingabo z'igihugu bishyirwaho nande? Ing.127
entries.a: Ni Ministeri zifite izo nzego mu nshingano zabo.

entries.q: Ibimenyetso n'amabara y'ibyapa by'ibinyabiziga bikoreshwa n'abayobozi bakuru b'igihugu bigenwa nande? Ing.128
entries.a: Ni Ministeri yo gutwara abantu n'ibintu.

entries.q: Vuga ahagaragara ikirangantego cy'igihugu ku byapa by'ibinyabiziga, haba ku modoka cg ku mapikipiki. Ing.128(Ikitonderwa)
entries.a: Kigaragara hejuru mu nguni y'ibumoso imbere naho inyuma ni mu nguni y'iburyo.

entries.q: Iyo ubuze icyapa ndanga ukora iki? Ing.129(1)
entries.a: Ubimenyesha bidatinze ibiro byabitanze.

entries.q: Izina, izina ry'ingereka n'icumbi bya nyirabyo bigomba kwandikwa he ku kinyabiziga? Ing.131
entries.a: Byandikwa imbere ku ruhande rw'ibumoso.

entries.q: Ni ryari ikinyabiziga cyemerewe kugendera mu muhanda cyambaye ibyapa by'igihugu cyaturutsemo? Ing.132
entries.a: Ni igihe ikinyabiziga kitazaguma mu gihugu ariko gifite ibyapa byemewe n'amasezerano mpuzamahanga.

entries.q: Ni ryari ikinyabiziga cyitwa ko kiri mu igeragezwa? Ing.133(1)
entries.a: Ni igihe kiri mu igeragezwa n'uwagikoze, n'uwagiteranije, Abasannyi bacyo, Abagishyiraho karisori, Abakigurisha.

entries.q: Ni ryari ikigo cyitwa ikigo gishinzwe igenzura ry'imiterere y'ibinyabiziga? Ing.136
entries.a: Ni igihe cymewe na Ministeri ishinzwe gutwara abantu n'ibintu, kandi gikora imirimo yo gusuzuma ikinyabiziga.

entries.q: Ninde wemerera ikigo kugenzura imitere y'ikinyabiziga? Ing.137
entries.a: Ni Ministiri ushinzwe gutwara abantu n'ibintu.

entries.q: Vuga ibintu byibura bitatu Umugenzuzi w'ikigo gishinzwe igenzura ry'imiterere agomba kuba yujuje? Ing.138
entries.a: Ubumenyi buhagije yavanye mu ishuri,; Kuba yarakoze byibura imyaka 5 ari umukanishi,; Ashoboye gusuzuma ikinyabiziga,; Ashoboye kuyobora no gucunga abakozi,; Ashoboye kugaragaza mu nyandiko ibyasuzumwe,; Yarahuguwe byibura mu gihe cy'amezi atatu.

entries.q: Vuga ibkoresho bitanu by'ibanze bipima n'iby'igerageza. Ing.139(A)
entries.a: Umunzani wo gupima uburemere kuri buri mutambiko,; Icyuma cyagenewe gusuzuma feri,; Imashini isuzuma icyerekezo cy'ibitara bimurika cyane,; Ibipimisho by'urumuri,; Igipimisho cya moteri.

entries.q: Vuga ibikoresho shingiro bikoreshwa by'inyongera bisuzuma ibinyabiziga. Ing.139(A6,A7)
entries.a: Ijeki kabuhariwe ,; Icyuma gipima niba imodoka itayumbayumba,

entries.q: Vuga ibikoresho 3 bipima n'iby'igerageza by'ibanze n'ibindi bibiri byangombwa.Ing.139(B)
entries.a: Umunzani wo gupima uburemere kuri buri mutambiko,; Icyuma cyagenewe gusuzuma feri,; Imashini isuzuma icyerekezo cy'ibitara bimurika cyane.; Icyuma gisuzuma ibyotsi bivuburwa n'imodoka.; Igipimisho cya moteri.

entries.q: Ni ibihe bikoresho by'inyongera bya ngombwa by'ikinyabiziga? Ing.139(B7,B8)
entries.a: Ijeki kabuhariwe ,; Icyuma gipima niba imodoka itayumbayumba,

entries.q: Vuga amoko byibura icumi y'imfunguzo z'ikinyabiziga. Ing.139(D)
entries.a: Imfunguzo zifite umutwe usatuye,; Imfunguzo zifite ku mutwe hahese,; Imfunguzo ndende zihese ku mutwe,; Urufunguzo rw'amaburo anyuranye,; Ipensi isanzwe,; Ipensi ikata ihese,; Turunevisi z'umutwe ugororotse,; Turunevisi z'umutwe usongoye,; Inyundo 2 zo kugorora,; Igifashi kizenguruka,; Umukasi w'abanyamashanyarazi,; Ipobo itera girisi,; Akabobeza byuma,; Igipimisho cya metero ebyiri,; Imfunguzo ebyiri z'umusaraba,; Imfunguzo za buji,; Imashini isuzuma muri rusange.

entries.q: Ni ibihe binyabiziga bisuzumwa buri mezi atandatu? Buri mwaka?Ing.142
entries.a: Ibinyabiziga bitwarira abantu hamwe ndetse n'ibitwara ibintu birengeje toni 3,5 ndetse n'ibyigishirizwaho bisuzumwa buri mezi 6, Ibisigaye ni rimwe mu mwaka.

entries.q: Amafaranga y'imirimo y'igenzura agenwa nande? Ing.144
entries.a: Agenwa n'iteka rya Ministiri w'ubucuruzi abisabwe na ministiri ushinzwe gutwara abantu n'ibintu.

entries.q: Sobanura mu magambo arambuye CNSR. Ing.145
entries.a: CNSR: Ni Komite ishinzwe umutekano mu muhanda.

entries.q: CNSR igizwe nabande: Prezida?Visi-prezida? Ugize inama? Umunyamabanga? Ing.145
entries.a: Prezida ni Umuyobozi wo gutwara abantu n'ibintu muri iyo Ministeri,; Visi-Prezida ni Komanda w'umutwe wa polisi y'igihugu ushinzwe umutekano mu mihanda.; Ugize inama: ni Umuyobozi ushinzwe amateme n'imihanda muri Ministeri ibishinzwe.; Umunyamabanga ni Ushinzwe ishami ry'umutekano mu muhanda muri Ministeri yo gutwara abantu n'ibintu.

entries.q: Iyi komite CNSR iterana mu gihe kingana iki? Itumizwa nande? Iyo impaka zivutse zikemurwa n'ijwi ryande?Ing.148
entries.a: Iterana rimwe mu mezi ane kandi itumizwa na Prezida wayo kandi n'iyo impaka zivutse zikemurwa n'ijwi rya Prezida.

entries.q: Agaciro k'ibyigwa na CNSR bigira agaciro hari abantu bangana iki? Ing.149
entries.a: Hagomba kuba hari byibura 2/3.

entries.q: Gufunga ikinyabiziga bitegekwa nande? Ing.152
entries.a: Bitegekwa n'umushinjacyaha mu karere akoreramo.

entries.q: Ni hehe hagenewe gufungira ibinyabiziga? Ing.153
entries.a: Ni muri Parking zemejwe na Ministiri ushinzwe gutwara abantu n'ibintu. Cg se abakuru b'intara n'abayobozi b'uturere.

entries.q: Ni ryari uva mu murongo wari urimo iyo mwagendanaga mu bangikanye?
entries.a: Uwuvamo ari uko ugiye guhindura icyerekezo.

entries.q: Ni ryari uta priorit wari ufite?
entries.a: Ni igihe uvuye mu muhanda mutoya uriye mu munini,; Igihe uyambuwe n'umukozi ubifitiye ububasha,; Igihe ugeze ku cyapa kiyikwambura,; Igihe uhuye n'ibinyabiziga ndakumirwa,; Igihe ubonye ko ikinyabiziga gitwarira abantu hamwe cyatangiye guhaguruka.

entries.q: Ni ikihe kimenyetso kigaragaza ko wahagaze umwanya munini ?
entries.a: Ni uko uba wajimije moteri.

entries.q: Ibimenyetso biromboreje birimo amoko angahe ?
entries.a: Birimo amoko 3; Umurongo ucagaguye,; Umurongo udacagaguye,; Umurongo ucagaguye ubangikanye n'udacagaguye.

entries.q: Ni umwanya ungana iki iyo ugiye guparika iruhande rw'icyapa?
entries.a: Usiga umwanya uhagije.
