entries.a: Iyo ikinyabiziga gikururwa n'ikindi

entries.q: Ni ibihe bintu buri ikinyabiziga kigomba kugira?
entries.a: Icyapa kiburira cya mpandeshatu ndinganire; Agahago k'ubutabazi karimo ibipfuko bine bitanduza, ibikwasi 4 bitifungura, agatabo kanditsemo iby'ubutabazi, agacupa k'umuti wica udukoko

entries.q: Ni ayahe matara aranga ikinyabiziga kandi akigaragaza ubugari bwacyo burebewe imbere?
entries.a: Amatara ndangambere

entries.q: Umurongo ugizwe na mpandeshatu zerekeje imitwe aho abayobozi b'ibinyabiziga baturuka umenyesha iki mumuhanda?
entries.a: Werekana aho abayobozi zireba bagomba guhagarara akanya gato niba bishoboka kugirango batange inzira bakurikije icyapa B1

entries.q: Umurongo mugari wera udacagaguye uciye kuburyo bugororotse ku nkengero y'umuhanda werekana iki?
entries.a: Aho abayobozi bategetswe guhagarara akanya gato babitegetswe n'icyapa (STOP) cyangwa ikimenyetso kimurika kerekana uburyo bwo kugenda mu muhanda

entries.q: Vuga uko ahantu abayobozi b'amagare n'aba velomoteri bafite imitende ibiri bambukiranya umuhanda haba hameze.
entries.a: Haba hari imirongo ibiri icagaguye iteganye, igizwe na za mpandenye ndinganire cyangwa ingirwamwashi

entries.q: Imyaka y'ifatizo ku nzego z'ibinyabiziga zibaho mu Rwanda ni ingahe? Vuga buri rwego n'imyaka yarwo.
entries.a: 20 ans: C,D,E na F; 18 ans: A na B; 17 ans: velomoteri/igare ihetse; 15 ans: velomoteri/igare yitwaye; 14 ans: ayoboye inyamaswa zikurura; 12 ans: ayoboye amatungo

entries.q: Ni ryari uva mumurongo wari urimo iyo mwagendaga mubangikanye?
entries.a: Ashobora gukatira ibumoso iyo yari ari mu murongo w'ibumoso; Ashobora gukatira iburyo iyo yari ari mu murongo w'iburyo

entries.q: Umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga uhinduye ikerekezo agomba gukora iki?
entries.a: Kubanza kubyerekana ku buryo buhagije nibura muri 50m akoresheje amatara ndanga y'ikinyabiziga cye, yaba atayafite agakoresha ukuboko kwe; Kugabanya umuvuduko; Kureka hagahita ibinyabiziga n'abanyamaguru bigenda mu muhanda avuyemo cyangwa biwugenda kuruhande; Kureka hagahita abanyamaguru bambukiranya umuhanda avuyemo cyangwa aganamo

entries.q: Iyo nta mategeko awugabanya birushijeho, umuvuduko ntarengwa ni uwuhe kubinyabiziga (vuga buri kimwe kimwe)?
entries.a: Ibinyabiziga bitarengeje 3500 kg: 80 km/h; Voiture, taxis: 70 km/h; Bus (3500-12500 kg): 60 km/h; Camions (>12500 kg) + velomoteri: 50 km/h; Tracteurs: 25 km/h

entries.q: Umuvuduko wo munsisiro uteye ute?
entries.a: 50 km/h: izitwara abantu; 40 km/h: izindi

entries.q: Iyo ibinyabiziga bigeze mu masangano aho banyura bagombye kuzenguruka (rond point), ari ibyagezemo ari n'ibigiye kwinjira, ni ibihe bitambuka mbere?
entries.a: Ibyagezemo nibyo bitambuka mbere

entries.q: Umuyobozi ugeze mu isangano aho ibimenyetso by'umuriro biyobora ibinyabiziga abigenza ate?
entries.a: Agomba guhita ava muri iryo sangano adategereje ko kugenda mucyerekezo ajyamo byemerwa, akabikora atabangamiye ibindi binyabiziga bifite uburenganzira bwo gutambuka

entries.q: Ni ibihe binyabiziga bigomba gukorerwa isuzumwa nibura 2 mu mwaka?
entries.a: Ibitwara abantu muri rusange; Ibyo bigiraho gutwara; Ibitwara ibintu birengeje toni 3,5

entries.q: Ni ryari ibinyabiziga bya gisilikare bidakurikiza amategeko agenga ibinyabiziga biherekeranyije mu butumwa?
entries.a: Iyo ari mu nsisiro; Kuva bwije kugeza bukeye; Iyo igihu cyabuditse

entries.q: Iyo abanyamaguru bagendera mu nzira nyabagendwa, ni uruhe ruhande bategetswe kugenderamo?
entries.a: Bategetswe kugendera ku nkengero z'umuhanda ku ruhande rw'ibumoso ukurikije ikerekezo baganamo; Abacunga za velomoteri na za moto bategetswe kunyura kuruhande rw'iburyo; Iyo ari umurongo w'abasilikare cyangwa umurongo w'abanyeshuli uyobowe n'umwalimu, banyura iburyo

entries.q: Ni ryari ibigereranyo (pictogrammes) bigomba gushyirwa ku ngasire (disque) imwe?
entries.a: Iyo ibibuzwa byinshi byubahirizwa ahantu hamwe, nyamara ntibishobora kurenga bitatu ku ngasire imwe

entries.q: Ubugari ntarengwa bw'imizigo yikorewe ni ubuhe?
entries.a: Velomoteri + Amagare + romoroki zikururwa n'utwo tunyabiziga zidafite udupine kuruhande: 0,75m; Moto zidafite akanyabiziga kuruhande: 1,25m; Ipikipiki ifite akanyabiziga na za romoroki zikuruwe na bene ibyo binyabiziga ntibishobora kurenza 30 cm ku bugari bw'ibyo binyabiziga bidapakiye; Ibinyamitende itatu cyangwa ine bifite cyangwa bidafite moteri: 30 cm ku bugari bw'ibyo binyabiziga; Ubugari rusange bw'imizigo ipakiwe n'ikibipakiye ntibushobora kurenza 2,50m

entries.q: Ni ryari bibujijwe kugenda ibumoso bw'umurongo wera udacagaguye?
entries.a: Igihe cyose birabujijwe

entries.q: Icyapa kibuza kurenza 80 km/h n'icyapa gitegeka kutajya munsi ya 80 km/h bitandukaniye he? Bishushanye.
entries.a: Icyapa kibuza kurenga 80 km/h kiba ari ingasire ifite umuzenguruko utukura, ubuso bw'umweru, na 80 yanditse mw'ibara ry'umukara; Naho icyapa gitegeka kutajya munsi ya 80 km/h kiba gifite ingasire ifite ubuso bw'ubururu na 80 byanditse n'ibara ryera

entries.q: Ibimenyetso bigenga uburyo bwo kugenda mu muhanda birimo uburyo bungahe? Buvuge.
entries.a: Butatu: Ibyapa; Ibimenyetso bimurika; Ibimenyetso byo mu muhanda

entries.q: Ibyapa (ibimenyetso) byo mumuhanda biri amoko angahe?
entries.a: Ibyapa biburira; Ibyapa byo gutambuka mbere; Ibyapa bibuza n'ibitegeka; Ibyapa biyobora

entries.q: Umuyobozi ugenda mumuhanda ugabanijwe n'umurongo ucagaguye abwirwa n'iki ko ari hafi kugera kumurongo udacagaguye?
entries.a: Abyerekwa n'umurongo ucagaguye uduce tugufi kandi twegeranye

entries.q: Ibimenyetso abayobozi b'ibinyabiziga ndakumirwa badakurikiza ni ibihe, mu gihe guhita kwabo kurangwa n'intabaza yihariye?
entries.a: Uretse ibyo bategekwa n'abakozi babifitiye ububasha, ntibategetswe kubahiriza amategeko agenga umuvuduko ntarengwa n'ay'ibimenyetso bimurika bigenga uburyo bwo kugenda mu muhanda

entries.q: Ibyapa biburira n'ibyo gutambuka mbere bifite amabara ki?
entries.a: Ibyapa biburira: Triangle umuzenguruko utukura, ubuso ni umweru, ikimenyetso ni umukara; Hariho ibyo gutambuka mbere bifite ubuso bw'umuhondo

entries.q: Ibyapa bibuza n'ibindi byapa bifite amabara ki?
entries.a: Ibyapa bibuza: Ingasire izengurutswe n'ibara ritukura, ubuso umweru, ikimenyetso ni umukara; Ibyapa bitegeka: Ubururu (ubuso), ikimenyetso ni umweru; Ibiyobora: ibyinshi ni ubururu, ikimenyetso umweru; Iby'ingoboka: Ubururu, ikimenyetso cy'umukara mu buso bw'umweru

entries.q: Umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga cyangwa w'ikinyamitende itatu (ine) bifite moteri agomba kugira aho yicara hafite ubugari butari munsi ya cm zingahe?
entries.a: Agomba kugira aho yicara hatari munsi ya 55 cm (iyo yicaranye n'abandi, ntibyemewe ko buri wese yajya munsi ya 40cm)

entries.q: Hagati y'ibinyabiziga biherekeranije mu butumwa bigamije urugendo rumwe hagomba kubamo byibura metero zingahe?
Ikinyabiziga cya mbere n'icya nyuma bikurikiranye mubutumwa bishyirwaho ibihe bimenyetso?
entries.a: Imbere: "ATTENTION CONVOI"; Inyuma: "FIN DE CONVOI"

entries.q: Vuga umubare ntarengwa w'inyamaswa zikurura ikinyabiziga zikururanye n'umubare ntarengwa zibangikanye.
entries.a: Ntushobora kurenga enye zikururanye n'esatu zibangikanye

entries.q: Isonga y'impombo yohereza ibyotsi ryerekezwa muruhe ruhande rw'ikinyabiziga?
entries.a: Mu ruhande rw'ibumoso

entries.q: Ninde ushyiraho ibimenyetso byerekana imirimo ikorerwa mu nzira? Bivanwaho ryari kandi nande?
entries.a: Ibimenyetso byerekana imirimo ikorwa bishyirwaho n'uyikora, bigakurwaho n'uyikora iyo imirimo ikimara kurangira

entries.q: Ninde ushyiraho ibimenyetso by'inkomyi mu nzira nyabagendwa?
entries.a: Ubutegetsi bushinzwe inzira nyabagendwa, iyo ari inkomyi itatewe n'umuntu; Uwayiteye

entries.q: Ni ryari abanyamaguru bagenda mumuhanda bategetswe kugendera kuruhande rw'iburyo aho kugendera ku ruhande rw'ibumoso?
entries.a: Imirongo yose y'ingabo n'agatsiko kose k'abanyamaguru bategetswe kugendera iburyo bw'umuhanda kandi bagasiga umwanya uhagije ibumoso ngo ibinyabiziga bihite

entries.q: Ni ibihe binyabiziga bitegetswe kugendera mu gice cy'umuhanda gikikijwe n'uduce tugari tw'imirongo tudafatanye tw'ibara ryera?
entries.a: Ibinyabiziga bigenda buhoro n'ibinyabiziga byagenewe gutwara abantu muri rusange

entries.q: Vuga ubwoko butatu bw'amatara yakira rimwe buri gihe.
entries.a: Amatara ndanga yakira rimwe n'amatara magufi n'amatara maremare (cyangwa kamenabihu)

entries.q: Ni ibihe binyabiziga bitegetswe kugira amatara ndangaburumbarare?
entries.a: Ibinyabiziga cyangwa imitwaro birengeje ubugari bwa 2,50m

entries.q: Ibikoresho ngarura-rumuli bigaragaza inkombe zombi z'inzira nyabagendwa bigomba kugaragara mu yahe mabara?
entries.a: Ku ruhande rw'iburyo bigomba kugaragara mw'ibara ritukura cyangwa risa n'icunga rihishije; Ibumoso rigaragaza ibara ryera

entries.q: Ni ibihe byapa bibujijwe gushyirwa ku nzira nyabagendwa?
entries.a: Ibyapa byamamaza ibimenyetso biranga cyangwa ibindi bikoresho bituma abayobozi b'ibinyabiziga bahuma; bayoba byerekana cyangwa byenda gusa naho cyaba igice n'ibyapa; byakwitiranywa n'uri kure n'ibyapa; cyangwa bikagirira nabi uburyo ubwo ari bwo bwose akamaro gahuje n'ibimenyetso bihuje n'amategeko

entries.q: Gereranya ibitegekwa n'abakozi babifitiye ububasha n'ibimenyetso bimurika.
entries.a: Ukuboko kuzamuye: itara ritukura; Amaboko atambitse: itara ritukura ku baturuka imbere n'inyuma (itara ry'icyatsi ku baturuka kuruhande); Ibitegetswe n'abakozi babifitiye ububasha birusha ububasha ibindi bimenyetso

entries.q: Ni ibihe binyabiziga bitari ngombwa kurangirwa kure n'ibimenyetso byabugenewe kugirango biburire hakiri kare abandi baza babigana, mu gihe cyose byaba bihagaritswe ahantu habujijwe?
entries.a: Amapikipiki na za velomoteri bidafite akanyabiziga kuruhande

entries.q: Vuga nibura abantu batatu bafite ububasha bwo kuyobora umuhanda.
entries.a: Aba ofisiye na ba suzofisiye ba polisi y'igihugu bari mu kazi; Ba kapulari ba polisi y'igihugu bari ku kazi; Abapolisi bashinzwe umutekano mu muhanda; Abakozi ba za gasutamo; Abakozi bashinzwe amateme

entries.q: Iyo impanuka yangije ibintu gusa cyangwa hakaba hari abakomeretse byoroshye, abayobozi bakora iki?
entries.a: Kuguma aho impanuka yabereye kugirango abyumvikaneho n'uwo bagonganye; Gufasha umukozi ubishinzwe kugirango abyirebere; Kubimenyesha umutegetsi ushinzwe amahoro uri hafi (igihe umukozi ubishinzwe atabonetse)

entries.q: Iyo habaye impanuka, umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga akora iki?
entries.a: Guhita ahagarara iyo bimushobokera kandi ntabangamire bushya uburyo bwo kugenda mu muhanda; Guhita yakiriza rimwe amatara ndanga cyerekezo; Kwerekana umwirondoro we iyo abandi babimusabye; Guhamagara abashinzwe amahoro; Iyo umuntu yapfiriye mu mpanuka cyangwa yakomeretse cyane, kudahindura ibimenyetso by'uko byari bimeze

entries.q: Uruhushya rw'agateganyo rwo gutwara ibinyabiziga gafite agaciro kubuhe bwoko bw'ibinyabiziga?
entries.a: Ubwoko bwose bw'ibinyabiziga

entries.q: Igice cy'inzira nyabagendwa kiri hagati y'imirongo ibiri yera icagaguye ibangikanye (kandi gifite ubugari budahagije kugirango imodoka zitambuke neza) kimenyesha iki?
entries.a: Agahanda k'amagare

entries.q: Ni ayahe mabara y'inyugguti ku byapa by'ibinyabiziga bikurikira: iz'abikorera ku giti cyabo, ibinyabiziga bya leta, ibigo bishamikiye kuri leta, ambassade, ibyanditse mu mazina bwite?
entries.a: Umukara (RAA 001 A); Ubururu (GR 001 A); Ubururu (GP 001 A); Icyatsi (ambassade) (01 CD 001 R); Umutuku

entries.q: Ni ryari ikinyabiziga kibujijwe guhagarara umwanya muto n'umunini mu ruhande ruteganye n'urw'ikindi kinyabiziga gihagazemo?
entries.a: Ku mihanda ibisikanirwamo, iyo ubugali butuma ibisikana rikorwa butakigeze kuri 6m; Ku mihanda y'icyerekezo kimwe, iyo ubugali bw'umuhanda usigaye butakigera kuri 3m

entries.q: Ni ryari imodoka ipakiye (nk'ikawa, ibyatsi) ishobora kurenza 2,75 m?
entries.a: Iyo ijya mu karere hatarengeje 25 km uvuye aho yapakiriwe

entries.q: Itara ryo gusubira inyuma ryaka ryari?
entries.a: Ryaka gusa iyo gusubira inyuma gutangiye

entries.q: Ugutangwa ku ibyapa ndanga biri kumwe n'ikarita iranga ikinyabiziga, bibanza gutangirwa imisoro bigenwa n'iteka rya nde?
entries.a: Minisitiri w'imari

entries.q: Ni ryari ikinyabiziga cyemererwa kugenda mu nzira nyabagendwa?
entries.a: Iyo cyambaye inimero zikiranga

entries.q: Ishyirwaho ry'ibimenyetso rigengwa na nde? (Art 91.4)
entries.a: Minisitiri ushinzwe gutwara abantu n'ibintu

entries.q: Ubusobanuro bw'icyapa gishobora kuzuzwa, gusiganuwa cyangwa kugenwa n'iki?
entries.a: N'ibyapa nyongera

entries.q: Iyo aho hantu hari kuri iyo nzira nyabagendwa, icyapa kiburira kikaba gishinze aho inzira nyabagendwa irasukira, bigenda bite? (Art 94.6)
entries.a: Icyapa k'inyongera gifite akarangakerekezo k'umukara gishobora kwerekana aho hantu habi

entries.q: Vuga umubare ntarengwa w'ibimenyetso bishobora gushyirwa ku ngasire imwe.
entries.a: Bitatu (3)

entries.q: Ibyapa bitegeka bishyirwa ahantu hameze hate? (Art 102)
entries.a: Ahantu birushijeho kubonwa neza n'abo bigenewe

entries.q: Ibyapa biyobora bigamije iki? (Art 103)
entries.a: Kuyobora no gusobanurira abagenzi b'inzira nyabagendwa

entries.q: Iyo ikimenyetso kimurika cyagenewe kuyobora ibinyabiziga kidakora, bigenda bite? (Art 104.6)
entries.a: Abayobozi bemerewe gukomeza, bapfa gusa kwiringira ko batabangamiye imigendere y'abandi

entries.q: Amatara ashyirwa kubimenyetso bimurika akurikirana ate? Mu buryo bwo kwaka akurikirana ate? (Art 105)
entries.a: Umutuku uba hejuru y'icyatsi; Umuhondo ukaba hagati y'umutuku n'icyatsi; Mu kwaka: Umuhondo waka nyuma y'icyatsi; Umutuku ukaka nyuma y'umuhondo; Icyatsi kikaka nyuma y'umutuku

entries.q: Ibimenyetso bimurika byerekana iki? Bishyirwa he? (Art 106)
entries.a: Uburyo bwo kugenda mu muhanda; Bishyirwa iburyo bw'umuhanda ukurikije igice cy'umuhanda uganamo, ariko bishobora no gushyirwa ibumoso cyangwa ahandi hose kugirango birusheho kugaragara neza

entries.q: Kugirango berekane ahantu habi cyane, hakoreshwa ikihe kimenyetso? Bivuga iki? (Art 107)
entries.a: Itara ry'umuhondo rimyatsa; bivuga ko uburenganzira bwo kurenga icyo kimenyetso burushijeho kwitonda

entries.q: Amatara cyangwa ibikoresho ngarura-rumuri bikoreshwa kubera iki? (Art 108)
entries.a: Bikoreshwa kugirango bigaragaze inzira nyabagendwa, bigomba gushyirwaho kuburyo abagenzi babona; Ibara ritukura iburyo, n'ibara ryera ibumoso

entries.q: Ibimenyetso byo mumuhanda bigenewe iki? (Art 109)
entries.a: Kugena uburyo bwo kugenda mu muhanda bigenewe gutunganya uburyo bwo kugenda mu muhanda, kuburira cyangwa kuyobora abagenzi

entries.q: Umurongo mugari udacagaguye ugaragaza iki? (Art 110.9)
entries.a: Ugaragaza inkombe z'umuhanda

entries.q: Erekanisha igishushanyo aho abanyamaguru bambukira. (Art 111.3)
entries.a: Imirongo y'ibara ryera iteganye n'umurongo ugabanya umuhanda mo kabiri mu burebure bwawo

entries.q: Erekanisha igishushanyo ahanyura amagare na za velomoteri. (Art 111.4)
entries.a: Imirongo ibiri icagaguye igizwe na za kare (mpande enye ndinganire) cyangwa ingirwamwashi by'ibara ryera

entries.q: Iyo imirimo cyangwa inkomyi biri ahantu hatoya, bigomba gushyirwaho ibihe bimenyetso? (Art 114.1)
entries.a: Hagati ya nimugoroba na mu gitondo: amatara yaka ku buryo buhagije kuburyo abonerwa muri 150m iyo ijuru rikeye, agaragara atukura kuruhande rwambukiranya umuhanda, akagaragaza ibara ryera cyangwa umuhondo kuburebure bw'umuhanda; Hagati ya mugitondo na nimugoroba: utubendera dutukura dufite nibura 50cm kuri buri ruhande; Icyapa kerekana ko hari imirimo ikorwa kuri buri mpera

entries.q: Igihe ikorwa ry'imirimo ribangamiye cyane cyangwa bike uburyo bwo kugenda mu muhanda, ahakorerwa imirimo hagaragazwa ku buryo bumeze bute? (Art 114.2)
entries.a: Ahitaruye hashyirwa icyapa kerekana ko hari imirimo ikorwa; Uruzitiro ruri ahakorwa imirimo ku mpera zombi

entries.q: Umuyobozi agomba gukora iki ngo yirinde kwangiza umuhanda? (Art 9)
entries.a: Kugenda buhoro; Kunyura indi nzira; Kugabanya ibyo ikinyabiziga kikoreye

entries.q: Ikinyabiziga cyose cyangwa ibinyabiziga bikururana bigomba kugira iki? (Art 10.1)
entries.a: Bigomba kugira ubiyobora

entries.q: Inyamaswa zigendera ku yihe nkombe? (Art 12.1)
entries.a: Zigendera ku nkombe y'iburyo

entries.q: Umuyobozi wese ugiye kugera mu nkomane agomba gukora iki? (Art 15.1)
entries.a: Kwitonda bihagije bijyanye n'uko aho agenda hameze; Kureba neza niba umuhanda agiye kwinjiramo nta nkomyi irimo; Kugenda agabanya umuvuduko akurikije ko atabona; Gutanga ikimenyetso y'uko ageze hafi

entries.q: Umuyobozi wese ushaka kugira aho agana ntashobora kubigira atabanje kwiringira iki? (Art 17.a)
entries.a: Ntashobora kubigira atabanje kwiringira ko nabigira ataza guteza ibyago cyangwa ngo abere inkomyi abandi bagenzi bamukikije, bamuri imbere cyangwa bagiye kubisikana, akabigira akurikije uko abandi bagenzi bari mu muhanda, aho bagana n'umuvuduko bafite

entries.q: Mbere yo gukata cyangwa kujya kuruhande rw'umuhanda, umuyobozi wese agomba mbere y'igihe gukora iki? (Art 17.c)
entries.a: Kubyerekana ku buryo budashidikanywaho akoresheje indanga-cyerekezo z'ikinyabiziga cye, cyangwa byaba bidakora, byamushobokera akabyerekanisha ukuboko

entries.q: Kubisikana no kunyuranaho bireba nde? (Art 19.1)
entries.a: Ibinyabiziga bigenda

entries.q: Kubisikana bikorwa muruhe ruhande? (Art 20.1)
entries.a: Muruhande rw'iburyo

entries.q: Kunyuranaho bikorerwa muruhe ruhande? (Art 21)
entries.a: Bikorerwa ibumoso

entries.q: Kunyuranaho bikorerwa iburyo ryari? (Art 21.1)
entries.a: Iyo ikinyabiziga ugiye kunyuraho kigiye gukatira ibumoso

entries.q: Mbere yo kugira uwo anyuraho, umuyobozi wese agomba kwiringira iki? (Art 21.2)
entries.a: Ko uwo agiye kunyuraho aterekanye ko ashaka kunyura ku wundi cyangwa kugana ibumoso; Ko nta nkomyi iri mu gisate agiye kunyuramo; Ko ashobora kugaruka muruhande rw'iburyo atabangamiye abandi bayobozi; Kwerekana icyo agiye gukora

entries.q: Agomba guhagarika ikinyabiziga cye akurikije iki? (Art 26.1)
entries.a: Aho ashobora kugeza amaso, n'imbere y'inkomyi yose idatunguranye

entries.q: Umugenzi uri mu nzira nyabagendwa, iyo asatiriwe n'ikinyabiziga ndakumirwa kirangwa n'intabaza ndangurura jwi yihariye, abigenza ate? (Art 37.1)
entries.a: Agomba kugihigamira, kandi byaba bishoboka agahagarara kugirango gihite

entries.q: Abagenda mu nzira nyabagendwa babujijwe kwata (couper) iki? (Art 38.2)
entries.a: Umurongo w'abasirikare; Umurongo w'udutsiko tw'abanyamaguru, bayobowe n'umwalimu; Uruhererekane

entries.q: Ni nde (bande) bemerewe kujya mu kinyabiziga igihe gishyirwa mu cyome (kiva mu cyome)? (Art 40.4)
entries.a: Abayobozi n'ababaherekeje

entries.q: Ni ryari amatara magufi, amatara ndanga n'amaremare bicanirwa rimwe? (Art 43.1)
entries.a: Iyo ari hagati yo kurenga no kurasa kw'izuba, cyangwa bitewe n'ibihu cyangwa imvura nyinshi bidashoboka kubona muri 100m

entries.q: Amatara magufi n'amaremare bigomba kuzima ryali? (Art 43.2)
entries.a: Iyo ikinyabiziga gihagaze

entries.q: Amatara maremare y'ikinyabiziga agomba kuzimwa ryali? (Art 43.3)
entries.a: Ikinyabiziga gihagaze; Iyo umuyobozi ahuye n'ikindi kinyabiziga; Iyo akurikiye ikindi kinyabiziga mu ntera ya 50m; Iyo hari urumuri ruhagije kumuhanda

entries.q: Amatara ashakisha acanwa ryali? (Art 43.8)
entries.a: Iyo ari ngombwa kandi bitabangamiye uburyo bwo kugenda mu muhanda

entries.q: Ese biremewe kuvuza ihoni ahegereye amatungo cyangwa inyamaswa? (Art 47.5)
entries.a: Oya

entries.q: Abanyamaguru bagenda mu muhanda nijoro, hatabona cyangwa hari ibinyabiziga byinshi, bagenda bate? (Art 48.5)
entries.a: Bagenda ku murongo

entries.q: Ubugari bw'ikinyabiziga cyangwa ibinyabiziga bikururana, nibirenze ku mubyimba wabyo (hatabariwemo amatara yerekana ikerekezo n'indorerwamo ziboneshwa), ntibishobora kurenza uruhe rugero? (Art 57.1)
Ubugari ntarengwa bwa romoroki ikuruwe n'ipikipiki, igare cyangwa velomoteri ni ubuhe? (Art 57.1.a et b)
entries.a: 75 cm kuri velomoteri, 125 cm kuri ipikipiki

entries.q: Utugarura rumuri tuba duteye dute? (Art 75.5)
entries.a: Nta tara na rimwe cyangwa akagarura-rumuri bishobora kuba bifunze kuburyo igice cyabyo cyo hasi kigaragara kiri hasi ya 40 cm kuva ku butaka, ku kinyabiziga kidapakiye; Kubijyanye n'itara ry'ikamena-bihu n'itara ryo gusubira inyuma, ibyo ntibyubahirizwa (Art 75.5); utugarura-rumuri two hejuru ntibishobora kurenza 1,20m uhereye ku butaka (Art 77.5)

entries.q: Ni ryari umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga ashobora kuzimya moteri, akayivanamo vitesi, igihe agenda ahamanuka?
entries.a: Igihe ikinyabiziga gikururwa n'ikindi kinyabiziga (uretse igihe gikururwa n'ikindi kinyabiziga), nta kinyabiziga gifite moteri gishobora kugenda mu muhanda ahamanuka, keretse igihe moteri itaka cyangwa igihe vitesi idakora. (Art 88.9)

entries.q: Ni ibihe bintu buri kinyabiziga kigomba kugira?
entries.a: Icyapa kiburira cya mpande eshatu zingana na 40 cm; Agahago k'ubutabazi karimo nibura ibipfuko 4 bitanduza, ibikwasi bine bitifungura, agatabo kanditsemo ibyubutabazi, agacupa k'umuti wica mikorobi. (Art 88.5)

entries.q: Umurongo ugizwe na mpandeshatu zerekeje imitwe, aho abayobozi b'ibinyabiziga baturuka, umenyesha iki mu muhanda?
entries.a: Werekana aho abayobozi bagomba guhagarara akanya gato iyo bishoboka, kugirango batange inzira hakurikijwe icyapa n° B.1. (Art 111.2)

entries.q: Umurongo mugari wera udacagaguye, uciye ku buryo bugororotse ku nkengero y'umuhanda, werekana iki?
entries.a: Werekana aho abayobozi bagomba guhagarara akanya gato bategetswe babyeretse n'icyapa (STOP) cyangwa ikimenyetso kimurika cyerekana uburyo bwo kugendera mu muhanda. (Art 111.1)

entries.q: Ni ryari uva mu murongo wari urimo iyo mwagendaga mubangikanye?
entries.a: a) Ashobora gukatira ibumoso iyo yari ari mu murongo w'ibumoso; b) Ashobora gukatira iburyo ari uko yari ari mu murongo w'iburyo. (Art 25.2)

entries.q: Umuvuduko wo mu nsisiro uteye ute?
entries.a: Imodoka zitwara abantu: 50 km/h; Ibindi binyabiziga byose: 40 km/h. (Art. 29.3)

entries.q: Iyo ibinyabiziga bigeze mu masangano aho banyura bagomba kuzenguruka (rond point), ari ibyageze mo n'ibigiye kwinjira, ni ibihe bitambuka mbere?
entries.a: Ni ibyageze mu isangano (umuyobozi ugiye kwinjira mu isangano agomba kureka ibinyabiziga byagezemo bikabanza bigahita). (Art 16.2)

entries.q: Ni ibihe binyabiziga bigomba gukorerwa isuzuma nibura kabiri mu mwaka?
entries.a: Ni ibinyabiziga bigenewe: gutwara abantu; gutwara ibintu birengeje toni 3,5; ibigo byigisha gutwara (auto-école). Buri mwaka ku bindi binyabiziga bitavuzwe haruguru. (Art 142.a)

entries.q: Ni ryari ibinyabiziga bya gisirikare bidakurikiza amategeko agenga ibinyabiziga biherekeranyije mu butumwa?
entries.a: a) Iyo ari mu nsisiro; b) Kuva bwije kugeza bukeye; c) Igihe igihu cyabuditse, kigatuma badashobora kureba neza muri metero 30 byibura. (Art 49.1)

entries.q: Ni ryari ibigereranyo bigomba gushyirwa ku ngasire (disque) imwe?
entries.a: Iyo ibibuzwa byinshi byubahiriwa ahantu hamwe, nyamara umubare w'ibigereranyo biteranirije ku ngasire imwe ntibishobora kurenga bitatu. (Art 101)

entries.q: Icyapa kibuza kurenza 80 km/h n'icyapa kigutegeka kutajya munsi ya 80 km/h bitandukaniye he?
entries.a: Icyapa kibuza kurenza km 80/h kirangwa n'uruziga (ingasire) izengurutswe n'ibara ritukura kandi ubuso bukera handitsemo 80 n'ibara ry'umukara; naho icyapa gitegeka kutajya munsi ya 80 km/h kerekanwa n'uruziga rusize ibara ry'ubururu handitsemo 80 n'ibara ry'umweru. (Cfr ibyapa)

entries.q: Ibyapa (ibimenyetso) byo mu muhanda biri mu byiciro/amoko angahe?
entries.a: Ibyapa bibuza; Ibyo gutambuka mbere; Ibimenyetso bibuza (ibitegeka); Ibyapa ndanga. (Art 92)

entries.q: Umuyobozi ugenda mu muhanda ugabanijwe n'umurongo ucagaguye abwirwa n'iki ko ari hafi kugera ku murongo udacagaguye?
entries.a: Iyo uduce tw'umurongo ucagaguye ari tugufi kandi twegeranye cyane, tuvuga ko umurongo ukomeza wegereje. (Art 110:2-3)

entries.q: Ibimenyetso abayobozi b'ibinyabiziga ntibategetswe gukurikiza ni ibihe, mu gihe guhita kwabo kurangwa n'intabaza yihariye?
entries.a: Uretse ibyo bategekwa n'abakozi babifitiye ububasha, ntibategetswe kubahiriza amategeko yerekeye umuvuduko ntarengwa n'ayerekeye ibimenyetso by'umuriro byerekana uburyo bwo kugenda mu muhanda. (Art 37:2)

entries.q: Ibyapa biburira n'ibyo gutambuka mbere biranga bite (amabara)?
entries.a: Akenshi ibyapa biburira n'ibyo gutambuka mbere biba ari mpande eshatu zingana bifite umuzenguruko utukura n'ubuso bwera harimo igishushanyo kirabura. (Ibyapa A)

entries.q: Ibyapa bibuza n'ibindi?
entries.a: Tuzabireba nyuma. (uyu murongo ntabwo ugaragaza igisubizo cyuzuye mu nyandiko)

entries.q: Ikinyabiziga cya mbere n'icya nyuma bikurikiranye mu butumwa bishyirwaho ibihe bimenyetso?
entries.a: Ikinyabiziga cya mbere mu binyabiziga biherekeranije mu butumwa kigomba gushyirwaho icyapa cy'umuhondo cyanditsweho munyuguti zitukura 'ATTENTION CONVOI' (kigasomeka neza muri m 100 ku manywa). Ikinyabiziga cya nyuma gifite icyapa cy'umuhondo cyanditsweho 'FIN CONVOI' gisomeka neza ku manywa muri m 100. (Kubijyanye n'ibinyabiziga bikururwa n'inyamaswa bigiye mu butumwa, bigomba kugabanywamo amatsinda atarengeje m 500 kandi hagati yayo hakaba nibura m 30.) (Art 49)

entries.q: Isonga y'impombo yohereza ibyotsi ryerekezwa mu ruhe ruhande rw'ikinyabiziga?
entries.a: Isonga y'impombo yohereza ibyotsi ntishobora kwerekezwa iburyo bw'ikinyabiziga (ryerekezwa ibumoso). (Art 86:2)

entries.q: Ni ryari abanyamaguru bagenda mu muhanda bategetswe kugendera ku ruhande rw'iburyo aho kugendera ku ruhande rw'ibumoso?
entries.a: Imirongo yose y'ingabo n'agatsiko kose k'abanyamaguru bari mu muhanda bategetswe kugendera ku ruhande rw'iburyo bw'umuhanda no gusiga ibumoso umwanya uhagije kugirango ibinyabiziga bihite. (Art 38.1)

entries.q: Ibikoresho ngarurarumuri bigaragaza inkombe zombi z'inzira nyabagendwa bigomba kugaragara mu yahe mabara?
entries.a: Iburyo ni ibara ritukura cyangwa risa n'icunga rihishije, n'aho ibumoso bwabo ni ibara ryera. (Imbibi ziri ku mpera z'ubwihugiko bw'abanyamaguru kandi ziri mu muhanda kimwe n'imbibi n'ibindi bikoresho bigenewe gutuma bagenda mu muhanda nta muvundo, zisigwa irangi ry'umuhondo ngarurarumuri - art 108.1.) (Art 108.2; Art 119)

entries.q: Ni ibihe binyabiziga bitari ngombwa kurangwa kure n'ibimenyetso byabugenewe kugirango biburire hakiri kare abandi baza babigana, mu gihe cyose byaba bihagaritswe ahantu habujijwe?
entries.a: Velomoteri cyangwa ipikipiki idafite akanyabiziga kari iruhande. (Art 32:6)

entries.q: Vuga nibura ibintu bine umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga agomba kuringanirizaho umuvuduko kugirango utamubera intandaro y'impanuka.
entries.a: Umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga agomba kuringaniza umuvuduko wacyo n'uko ahantu: hameze; habona; imimerere y'umuhanda; imimerere y'ikinyabiziga n'ibyo kikoreye; imiterere y'ikirere; ubwinshi bw'ibigenda. (Art 26:1)

entries.q: Vuga nibura abantu batatu bafite ububasha.
entries.a: Ba ofisiye na sous-ofisiye bo muri Polisi y'Igihugu igihe bari ku kazi; Abapolisi bo mu mutwe ushinzwe umutekano mu muhanda; Abakozi ba Gasutamo; ... (Art 3)

entries.q: Uruhushya rw'agateganyo rwo gutwara ibinyabiziga rufite agaciro ku buhe bwoko bw'ibinyabiziga?
entries.a: Uruhushya rw'agateganyo rwo gutwara ibinyabiziga rufite agaciro ku nzego zose z'ibinyabiziga (rumara amezi atatu, cyongerwa incuro imwe gusa). (Art 6.5.b)

entries.q: Igice cy'inzira nyabagendwa kiri hagati y'imirongo yera icagaguye ibangikanye (kandi gifite ubugari budahagije kugirango imodoka zitambuke neza) kimenyesha iki?
entries.a: Kiba ari agahanda k'amagare. (Art 110.6)

entries.q: Ni ayahe mabara y'inyuguti ku byapa by'ibinyabiziga bikurikira: iz'abikorera ku giti cyabo, ibinyabiziga bya Leta, ibigo bishamikiye kuri Leta?
entries.a: Ibyapa byose biranga imodoka bifite ibara ry'umweru ku ruhande rw'imbere n'umuhondo ku ruhande rw'inyuma (ibyapa by'amapikipiki n'ibindi byuma by'imipira myinshi bifite ibara ry'umuhondo). Amabara y'inyuguti: Abikorera: umukara; Ibyavuye mu mahanga n'abacuruzi: umukara; Iza Leta n'ibigo bishamikiyeho: ubururu; ONG, Ambassaderi: icyatsi; Ibyinjiye by'agateganyo: umukara; Imishinga ikorera mu Rwanda: ubururu; UN: ubururu; Amazina bwite y'abanyenzabiziga: umutuku. (Art 126)

entries.q: Ni ryari imodoka ipakiye ishobora kurenza metero 2,75 z'ubugari (urugero: kawa, ibyatsi)?
entries.a: Igihe iyo mizigo ijyanwa mu karere katarenza kilometero 25 uvuye aho yapakiriwe (ubugari bushobora kugera kuri metero 3). (Art 61.1.c)

entries.q: Ugutangwa kw'ibyapa ndanga biri kumwe n'ikarita iranga ikinyabiziga bibanza gutangirwaho amafaranga agenwa n'iteka rya nde?
entries.a: Minisitiri w'imari. (Art 135.1)

entries.q: Vuga uko ahantu abayobozi b'amagare n'aba velomoteri zifite imitende ibiri bambukiranya umuhanda haba hameze.
entries.a: Haba hari imirongo ibiri icagaguye iteganye, igizwe na za mpandenye ndinganire cyangwa ingirwamwashi.

entries.q: Iyo habaye impanuka umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga akora iki?
entries.a: Guhita ahagarara iyo bimushobokera kandi ntabangamire bundi bushya uburyo bwo kugenda mu muhanda; guhita yakiriza rimwe amatara ndangacyerekezo; kwerekana umwirondoro we iyo abandi babimusabye; guhamagara abashinzwe amahoro; iyo umuntu yapfiriye mu mpanuka cyangwa yakomeretse cyane, kudahindura ibimenyetso by'uko byari bimeze.

entries.q: Ni ryari imodoka ipakiye, kawa, ibyatsi ishobora kurenza 2,75 m?
entries.a: Iyo ijya mu karere hatarengeje kilometero 25 uvuye aho yapakiriwe.

entries.q: Ibyapa byo ku muhanda bigomba gushingwa ku ruhe ruhande rw'umuhanda? Ku buhe buryo? (Art 92.2)
entries.a: Ku ruhande rw'iburyo ukurikije ikerekezo uganamo, bidashobora kujya munsi ya 1,50 m cyangwa hejuru ya 2,10 m.

entries.q: Ubusobanuro bw'icyapa gishobora kuzuzwa, gusobanurwa cyangwa kugenwa n'iki?
entries.a: N'ibyapa nyongera.

entries.q: Iyo ahantu icyago cyaranzwe ari harehare, uburebure bw'igice cy'inzira nyabagendwa icyo cyago kirimo bushobora kwerekanwa n'ikihe cyapa? (Art 94.4)
entries.a: N'icyapa nyongera kerekana F1.

entries.q: Amatara ashyirwa ku bimenyetso bimurika akurikirana ate? Mu buryo bwo kwaka akurikirana ate? (Art 105)
entries.a: Umutuku uba hejuru y'icyatsi, umuhondo ukaba hagati y'umutuku n'icyatsi. Mu buryo bwo kwaka: umuhondo waka nyuma y'icyatsi, umutuku ukaka nyuma y'umuhondo, icyatsi kikaka nyuma y'umutuku.

entries.q: Ibimenyetso byo mu muhanda bigenewe iki? (Art 109)
entries.a: Kugena uburyo bwo kugenda mu muhanda, bigenewe gutunganya uburyo bwo kugenda mu muhanda, kuburira cyangwa kuyobora abagenzi.

entries.q: Igice cy'inzira nyabagendwa kigarukira ku mirongo ibiri yera icagaguye ibangikanye kandi gifite ubugari budahagije kiba kigenewe iki? (Art 110.6)
entries.a: Agahanda k'amagare.

entries.q: Ibimenyetso by'inkomyi bishyirwaho na nde? (Art 113.2) Iyo imirimo cyangwa inkomyi biri ahantu hatoya bigomba gushyirwaho ibihe bimenyetso? (Art 114.1)
entries.a: Bishyirwaho n'ubutegetsi bushinzwe inzira nyabagendwa, iyo ari inkomyi itatewe n'umuntu, cyangwa n'uwayiteye. Hagati ya nimugoroba na mu gitondo: amatara yaka ku buryo buhagije kugirango abonerwe muri metero 150 iyo ijuru rikeye, akagaragaza ibara ryera cyangwa umuhondo ku burebure bw'umuhanda. Hagati ya mu gitondo na nimugoroba: utubendera dutukura dufite nibura 50 cm kuri buri ruhande, n'icyapa kerekana ko hari imirimo ikorwa kuri buri mpera.

entries.q: Igihe ikorwa ry'imirimo ribangamiye cyane cyangwa buke uburyo bwo kugenda mu muhanda, ahakorerwa imirimo hagaragazwa ku buryo bumeze bute? (Art 114.2)
entries.a: Ahitaruye hashyirwa icyapa kerekana ko hari imirimo ikorwa; uruzitiro ruri ahakorwa imirimo ku mpera zombi.

entries.q: Kugenda ku mirongo ibangikanye byemewe he? (Art 12)
entries.a: Mu mihanda y'icyerekezo kimwe igihe umuhanda ufite nibura ibice bibiri; ku gice cya kabiri cy'iburyo iyo kubisikana ku muhanda byemewe ku muhanda ufite ibisate byinshi; abakozi babifitiye ububasha bashobora no kubitegeka.

entries.q: Kubisikana bikorwa mu ruhe ruhande? (Art 20.1)
entries.a: Mu ruhande rw'iburyo.

entries.q: Kunyuranaho bikorerwa mu ruhe ruhande? (Art 21)
entries.a: Bikorerwa ibumoso.

entries.q: Kunyuranaho bikorewe iburyo ryari? (Art 21.1)
entries.a: Iyo ikinyabiziga ugiye kunyuraho kigiye gukatira ibumoso.

entries.q: Iyo nta mategeko awugabanya, umuvuduko ntarengwa w'ibinyabiziga uteye ute? (Art 29.2)
entries.a: 80 km/h; 70 km/h: ibitwara abantu by'umwihariko bitarengeje 3500 kg; 60 km/h: entre 3,5-12,5 tones; 50 km/h: velomoteri na camion; 25 km/h: tracteurs.

entries.q: Umugenzi uri mu nzira nyabagendwa asatiriwe n'ikinyabiziga ndakumirwa kirangwa n'intabaza ndangurura jwi yihariye, abigenza ate? (Art 37.1)
entries.a: Agomba kugihigamira, kandi byaba bishoboka agahagarara kugirango gihite.

entries.q: Amatara magufi n'amaremare bigomba kuzima ryari? (Art 43.2)
entries.a: Iyo ikinyabiziga gihagaze.

entries.q: Amatara maremare y'ikinyabiziga agomba kuzimwa ryari? (Art 43.3)
entries.a: Ikinyabiziga gihagaze; iyo umuyobozi ahuye n'ikindi kinyabiziga; iyo akurikiye ikindi kinyabiziga muri metero 50; iyo hari urumuri ruhagije ku muhanda.

entries.q: Umubare w'inyamaswa zikurura ikinyabiziga ni zingahe? (Art 51.1)
entries.a: 4 zikurikiranye, 3 zibangikanye.

entries.q: Ubugari bw'ikinyabiziga cyangwa ibinyabiziga bikururana, ntibirenze ku mubyimba wabyo hatabariwemo amatara yerekana ikerekezo n'indorerwamo ziboneshwa, ntibishobora kurenza uruhe rugero? (Art 57.1)
Ibimenyetso bikoreshwa kugirango berekane impera y'inyuma y'imizigo ntibishobora gushyirwa ku buhagarike burenze uruhe rugero? (Art 63)
entries.a: 1,55 m uhereye ku butaka.

entries.q: Utugarura-rumuri tuba duteye dute? (Art 75.5)
entries.a: Nta tara na rimwe cyangwa akagarura-rumuri bishobora kuba bifunze ku buryo igice cyabyo cyo hasi kimurika cyaba kiri munsi ya 40 cm uhereye ku butaka, igihe ikinyabiziga kidapakiye. Icyakora, ibi ntibikurikizwa ku itara kamenabihu no ku itara ryo gusubira inyuma. (Utugarura-rumuri ahari hejuru ntihashobora kurenza metero 1,20 - Art 77.5.)
